people.imagined: On a salt-marsh dyke at low tide, planting rice seed in grey mud, punt-pole on her shoulder. She squints against the glare as her father did, sure the marsh will grow rice.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a salt-marsh dyke at low tide in glare, she squints toward the horizon with a hopeful, stubborn look, a long punt-pole over her shoulder. Face, most important: a long pole of tempered pale bamboo resting over her right shoulder with its iron-shod foot at the top of the frame edge, and white salt crystals sparkling in a thick braid. A tall, sun-dark woman of thirty-two with a long jaw, deep creases at the eyes from squinting, dark brown skin, steady dark eyes, thick straight brows, a wide frank mouth. Fine sun-lines fan from the corners of her eyes, her lower lip is chapped and split at one corner by salt wind, and a faint tan-line shows where a straw hat sits. Hair: black, in one long thick braid over the shoulder, salt-whitened at the ends. Body: tall, long-armed, strong. Clothing: a hemp robe dyed green-grey, clean and well cut, with the true disciple's pale green silk collar, sleeves tied up, and a thin reed-coloured cape of salt-marsh grass over the shoulders, its fringe damp at the hem. The robe's green-grey is faded to a soft sage at the shoulders by sun, the sleeves tied above the elbow with two loops of brown cord, the pale green silk of the true-disciple collar edged with a thin line of grey salt crust; the reed cape is woven in overlapping tiers like roof thatch, tied at the throat with a knot of twisted marsh grass; a worn bamboo-fibre belt holds a small gourd of seed rice. Hands: one hand steadying the pole, the other holding a pinch of rice seed. Background: grey mud flats shining with water, a low sun, a distant row of piers. Far behind her a line of low dykes cuts the grey mud into rectangles, a single heron stands in a shallow pool, and a thin column of smoke rises from a distant salt-boiler's hut under a huge pale sky. Light: harsh bright coastal light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-green water-mist hint. Expression: squinted eyes against the glare, a hopeful, stubborn set to the jaw and a small determined smile.

people.imagined: A foundling prodigy at his master's table, quick hands crossing a needle through the air, fixed look on the viewer. He wonders who left him on the step.
people.subject: The moment: at a medicine table, he stops with a thin gold-tipped needle upright between two fingers and fixes the viewer with an unwavering stare, measuring them, and wondering who left him on the step. Face: most important, a strip of faded older green silk sewn inside his plain collar, showing as a pale green edge at the neck, and the long steel needle held upright between his fingers. It is a thin, sharp-boned, pale face of thirty-four, with narrow intense dark eyes that do not blink, straight thin brows, a straight nose, a closed thin mouth and a faint vertical crease between the brows from constant concentration. Hair: black, tied in a tight topknot with a plain bone pin. Body: slim, upright and ready. Clothing: the plain green-grey hemp inner-gate robe, clean and exactly pressed, with narrow buttoned cuffs, a close collar closed to the throat and edged with the old green silk, faded to the colour of a pond leaf with tiny hand stitches in darker thread, and a dark green cord belt with a small flat leather needle case tucked into it. Hands and objects: the needle raised in the right hand, the left flat beside a few dried polygala roots, the fingers long and the nails cut short and square; a faint pale green sheen at the needle. Background: shelves of squat grey-glazed jars, a bundle of dried polygala on a nail, a brass scale with two small pans, and a paper window casting a cool square of light onto the table. Light: clear cool light from the upper left. Expression: ambitious and intense, a watchful, hiding stillness, the stare of a foundling who has learned that people are to be read.

people.imagined: The outer-gate master in a spirit field at morning, leaning on his hoe and pointing with it. He has waited forty years for one Earth-only disciple to pass.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a spirit field at morning, he leans both hands on the top of a long hoe and points with its blade toward a distant row, patient; he has waited forty years for one Earth-only disciple to pass. Face: most important, a grey beard cut square at the chest and a long wooden hoe used as a staff and pointer, its iron blade honed bright with use. It is a broad, slow, brown-weathered face of about fifty-eight, with deep furrows at the brow, small kind brown eyes, heavy grey brows, a blunt nose, a quiet mouth, deep creases from the nostrils to the corners of the mouth, and large ears with grey hair in them. Hair: iron grey, tied in a plain knot under a wide straw hat that hangs behind his neck on a cord. Body: stocky, bowed shoulders, solid. Clothing: a clean hemp robe dyed green-grey, darkened to slate at the hem by damp, brown canvas over-sleeves for field work tied at the wrist. Hands and objects: both hands on the hoe, the handle dark and smooth where his palms grip it, the backs of the hands freckled with age-spots and spidered with old veins; a faint brown-green earth haze. Background: terraced fields stepping down the hillside in neat green rows with pale sprouts, a stone marker at the end of each terrace, low mist in the furrows, a few crows picking along an edge. Light: low morning light from the upper left. Expression: patient and humble, steady, the unhurried look of a man who has outwaited everything.

people.imagined: At a meeting in the seed vault, her knee jiggling under the table; she is afraid she will not reach the next stage. Seeds in a bowl before her.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low table in a vault of seed jars, she looks up with an anxious smile, her shoulders rocking slightly as a knee jiggles under the table; she is afraid she will not reach the next stage. Face: most important, a round freckled face scattered with pale-gold sun freckles across the nose, cheeks and even the eyelids, soft and open. She is about thirty-eight, fair, with warm brown eyes, soft straight brows, a short nose, ears pink at the tips from nerves, and a wavering friendly mouth with the lower lip slightly bitten. Hair: light brown, in a thick low braid pinned up with a green cord. Body: round and small, shoulders lifted. Clothing: a clean, soft, pale green-grey hemp robe with the inner-gate green silk collar loosely knotted, a grey apron with a deep front pocket holding a few seeds, a brass key on a red cord swinging against her chest, and sleeves cuffed back once, the wrists showing faint ink smudges. Hands and objects: both hands cup a small clay bowl of pale seeds, with a faint green sparkle in them. Background: shelves of lidded clay jars in three sizes, glazed brown and green, each with a knotted cord round its neck; a low brazier warms the vault and a paper lantern hangs from a rafter. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: cautious and trusting, anxious, a hopeful, uncertain smile that asks to be liked.

people.imagined: On the ridge at dusk the steward walks with two buckets on a yoke, watering the life trees. He almost never speaks; he wants to be buried among them.
people.subject: The moment: on a mountain ridge at dusk, he trudges toward the viewer with a wooden yoke across his shoulders, a water bucket hanging at each side, silent, watering the life trees; he wants to be buried among them. Face: most important, a carrying yoke across both shoulders with two wooden buckets dripping at the edges of the frame, and a deeply stooped, weathered face. He appears about sixty-five, with dark leathery skin, small steady black eyes under drooping lids, heavy grey brows, a long nose, a closed thin mouth, hollowed cheeks, folds of skin at the neck and a pale old scar across the chin. Hair: thin white, tied in a short tail. Body: stooped, long-boned and tough. Clothing: the undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, clean, dry and stiff with age, carefully mended at both knees and the cuffs in grey thread, with a rope belt knotted twice. Hands and objects: gripping the yoke ropes; the yoke worn glossy where it rests on his shoulders, with a folded cloth beneath for padding; a faint green-brown mist at his feet. Background: a line of small saplings marked with knotted cords climbing the ridge, an ancient pine bending sideways against a lavender sky, mist filling the valley far below. Light: low gold dusk light from the upper left. Expression: loyal and patient, withdrawn, a silent, inward face that has said what it has to say to the trees.

people.imagined: She sits at the edge of a still pool with both burn-scarred hands in the water, watching the surface. She wants to die by water and teach the method to one person.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at the edge of a still pool she looks up from her reflection, calm, both hands resting in the water; she wants to die by water and teach the method to one person. Face: most important, both hands marked with pale shiny burn-scars up to the wrist, resting half in clear water, and the reflection of her face unmoving in the pool. It is a pale, thin, composed face of about sixty, skin like milk with fine lines at the eyes, with a band of pale shiny scar tissue from the left temple into the hairline, pale grey eyes, long lashes, level brows, a straight nose and a thin quiet mouth, a little dry, with a stillness almost like a painted figure. Hair: black, loose to the shoulders, a single green cord at the temple and a plain wooden comb at the nape. Body: slender and still. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe of the inner gate with wide sleeves pushed above the wrists, a grey-blue cord sash holding the crossed collar, the hems dark with wet where they trail near the water. Hands and objects: both hands in the water, the burn-scars showing as pale glossy areas along the bare forearms; a faint pale blue sheen on the water. Background: a green-grey pool rimmed with smooth grey stones and ferns, a single leaf floating on the glass-flat surface, the far bank dissolving into soft green mist. Light: soft cool light from the upper left, water glints on the face. Expression: calm and reclusive, loyal, a still, closed look as if the water were the only listener.

people.imagined: The herder in his last two years at Trúc Cơ, sitting under the cattle's tree with a flute, the herd listening. He wants Kết Đan in spring or a quiet place.
people.subject: The moment: sitting under a tree with a bamboo flute at his lips lowered, listening to a herd that stands about him. Face, most important: a missing set of teeth on one side, so a pronounced hollow at the left cheek and a gap in his smile, and a bamboo flute thrust through his belt. Age appearing about sixty-five; brown, deeply weathered face; sharp bright dark eyes; white eyebrows; a broad flat nose; a wide, partly toothless smile. His cheek on the toothless side is sunken so the cheekbone stands out like a ridge, his skin is stained deep brown with a network of fine lines, and his eyes crinkle almost shut when he smiles. Hair: white, long, in a low tail, with a green cord. Body: thin, spare, long limbs. Clothing: a green-grey hemp robe, clean and plain, tied with a rope belt, with a herder's leather arm-guards; the hem damp. The robe is soft with washing, the green-grey faded to near grey, mended at the hem with brown thread; leather arm-guards are laced to his forearms, cracked and polished from cattle ropes, and a worn rope belt holds the flute, whose bamboo is darkened by decades of handling. Hands: the flute lowered in the right hand; at his knee stands Lão Hoàng, the dun lead cow, a spirit beast with one horn broken short. Background: behind him the broad shapes of resting cattle stand in the shade of a huge old tree with low spreading branches, a calf lying among the roots, and golden grass stretches to a distant blue ridge. Light: warm late sun from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-gold haze. Expression: a content, listening face with lowered flute and eyes that hold a quiet, wistful hunger, lips slightly parted.

people.imagined: In the port-house office, ink on his middle finger, the abacus in his sleeve, adding the price of every pill in the cape in his head and the lintel of his clan hall.
people.subject: The moment: at a port-house desk, he looks up from a column of figures with a bland, courteous expression while his fingers move as if over beads. Face, most important: a black ink stain across the middle finger of the right hand held up, and the wooden frame of an abacus poking from his sleeve. A neat, clean-shaven, pale face of thirty-five; sleek dark brows; sharp small dark eyes; a straight nose; a polite flat smile. His cheeks are smooth and a little pale, a faint line of ink sits at the edge of his chin where he has rubbed it, and a small dark mole lies near the left corner of his mouth. Hair: black, oiled, in a tight neat topknot with a jade pin. Body: slight, precise, upright. Clothing: a green-grey hemp robe, clean and perfectly pressed, with a green-silk port-house collar band and a dark sash; neat narrow sleeves. His robe is pressed so sharply the sleeves show creases, the green silk band of the port-house collar is lined with a thin line of embroidered waves, the sash is dark grey with a small jade toggle, and the abacus frame in his sleeve is dark rosewood with brass edging. Hands: one hand holds a brush over a book of columns; the abacus frame shows in the other sleeve. Background: a blurred office with a harbour window and boats. Behind him through a latticed window one sees masts and the grey-blue glimmer of a harbour, while a shelf of ledgers bound in blue cloth and a small brass scale sit on the desk's edge. Light: bright sea light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-green water haze. Expression: a bland, courteous face with a polite half-smile while the eyes move quickly, tallying.

people.imagined: In the furnace hall, thin and very still, perilla-purple on her fingertips, admired and cold. A sealed shelf is behind her, and she stands to hide it.
people.subject: The moment: standing perfectly still in front of a shelf, she looks at the viewer with a cold, level gaze, keeping herself between them and the shelf. Face, most important: bright perilla-purple stains on her fingertips and nails, both hands held clasped at her waist, and a very thin sharp-boned face. A narrow face of about thirty-five; pale grey skin; dark cool eyes; straight thin brows; a sharp nose; a closed pale mouth. There are faint hollows under her cheekbones, her lips are thin and nearly colourless, and a delicate vertical line sits between her brows like a ruled stroke. Hair: black, in a severe tight knot with a green jade pin. Body: very thin, tall, rigid. Clothing: a green-grey hemp robe of the inner gate, immaculate, with a charcoal-dark apron and sleeves tied back; a green silk collar. Her robe is immaculate and rather too well pressed for a furnace hall; the charcoal-grey apron has a pocket for needles, her sleeves are tied back with a plain cord to the elbow, and the purple stain runs from her fingertips up to the first knuckle of each hand like dye. Hands: clasped, purple-stained. Background: a dim furnace hall with a green glow and a closed lacquered shelf. Behind her a tall lacquered shelf with a black latch stands closed; beyond it a furnace mouth glows soft green and a ladder of iron tongs hangs on the wall. Light: green furnace light from the lower left, dark at the right. Qi: a faint green-purple haze. Expression: a cold, composed face with a level gaze and a still, closed mouth, tension only in the shoulders.

people.imagined: The founder's descendant on the ridge, fed up with being a relic, looking out with the founder's long eyes and wanting to grow magnolias like anyone.
people.subject: The moment: standing on the ridge, she turns away from an unseen elder with a flash of impatience, then back to the viewer with a restless, hopeful look; she is fed up with being a relic and wants to grow magnolias like anyone. Face: most important, very long, narrow, upturned eyes, the founder's eyes, dark and bright, set in a small delicate face. She is about twenty-four, with pale gold skin, thin arched brows, a small straight nose, a quick wry mouth with the upper lip slightly short so the lips sit just parted, and a faint blush of impatience on the cheekbones. Hair: black, long and loose to the waist, a single magnolia bud tucked at the ear. Body: slight, quick and light. Clothing: the undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, crisp and unnaturally fine, spotless but for small dirt marks from the garden, with the green-silk collar band loosened and a relic's sash tied in a careless knot, the sleeves pushed above the elbow. Hands and objects: one hand holds a small magnolia sapling in a clay pot; a faint pale green sparkle on the leaves. Background: a ridge of ancient pines rising through mist, a moss-covered stone lantern to one side, and a row of tiny clay pots of magnolia seedlings on a low wall. Light: pale morning light from the upper left. Expression: impatient and restless, a bit sly, the quick wry look of a girl who has run out of patience with being looked at.

people.imagined: The hardest fighter on the ridge holds out his hands, pine soot ground in every line, as if daring someone to laugh at his Metal.
people.subject: The moment: he stands braced and looks at the viewer with narrowed eyes, both hands held open and forward, palms out, daring them to laugh at his Metal. Face: most important, palms black with pine soot in every line and crease, held out wide, and a hard, heavy-jawed face. He is about thirty-five, with dark weathered skin, narrow grey eyes, thick straight brows with a scar notching one, a flat broken nose, thin tight lips pushed slightly out as if chewing something bitter, and heavy ears flattened at the tops. Hair: black, cropped very short. Body: massive shoulders on a short thick neck, solid as a stump. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, clean, with a tight ridge-cut sleeveless vest over it, a wide leather belt holding it snug, every seam double stitched in black thread, and plain brass bracers on the forearms, dented by blows, with a faint steel sheen. Hands and objects: palms facing out, black with soot. Background: a bare rock ridge of grey slabs cutting the sky, one lone pine standing crooked in the gap. Light: hard grey light from the upper left, a flat wet-looking light on the stone and a steel-grey gleam at the bracers. Expression: brave and cruel, loyal, a hard, daring set to the mouth, the stare of the hardest fighter on the ridge.

people.imagined: She smooths a passing sleeve without thinking, a cloth-seller's habit, her hands quick. She has never forgotten a face on the list.
people.subject: The moment: reaching out to smooth the sleeve of the viewer with quick light fingers, smiling warmly, a cloth-seller's habit; she has never forgotten a face on the list. Face: most important, two long, slender, quick hands in the foreground smoothing a sleeve, and a warm, bright, remembering face. It is a round, friendly face of thirty-four, golden-brown, with bright dark eyes that look straight at one, long curled lashes, soft arched brows, a small nose, a quick wide smile and tiny laugh-lines at the corners of the eyes; a small gold stud shows in one earlobe. Hair: black, in a loose bun with a green cloth ribbon. Body: small, quick and gracious. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with the sleeves fitted at seamstress-perfect hems, a pale green silk inner-gate collar smoothed flat, a bright yellow cloth tape measure round the neck, and a silver thimble ring glinting on her right forefinger. Hands and objects: smoothing a fold of fabric; a faint green warmth around the fingers. Background: a bright green-painted door set in a whitewashed wall, a rack of folded cloth bolts to one side, red paper lanterns hanging under the eaves. Light: warm daylight from the upper left. Expression: a warm, quick smile with bright, remembering eyes and an easy, generous mouth.

people.imagined: On the osmanthus terraces she copies a book before the paper rots, her right thumb cramped into a hook around the brush.
people.subject: The moment: seated among osmanthus trees, she looks up from copying with a mild, unhurried gaze, the brush still in her hand. Face, most important: her right thumb cramped into a stiff hook round the brush shaft, plainly crooked, held up, and a tiny cluster of osmanthus flowers tucked in her hair. A quiet, plain, oval face of thirty-five; light brown skin; patient dark eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a modest closed mouth. Her eyes are slightly bloodshot from long copying, there is an ink-dot freckle by her nose, and the skin under her eyes is shadowed lilac. Hair: black, in a plain bun with a few golden osmanthus flowers. Body: slim, a little stooped. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe, sleeves tied up with a cord, a pale apron with ink dots, a green silk collar. Her robe's sleeves are tied back with cord, an ink-spotted pale apron covers the front, a green silk collar peeks at the neck, and a small felt pad hangs from her belt on which she rests her wrist; the cramped thumb is thick-knuckled and bent at the joint. Hands: the hooked thumb holding a brush over a bound book. Background: blurred terraces with gold-flowered trees. Behind her terraced slopes of osmanthus trees rise in rows, their tiny gold flowers like scattered coins, a low table with a bound book and a stone ink slab stands under a straw canopy. Light: soft light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-gold sparkle. Expression: a mild, unhurried gaze with soft, patient eyes and a modest, steady mouth.

people.imagined: A wheat farmer's son, smiling slowly, a beat after everyone else has stopped, with earth on his hands from a plough.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a field, his smile spreads slowly across his face a beat after everyone else has finished laughing, a hand resting on a plough handle. Face: most important, a broad slow smile just beginning, late, on an open round face, and a plough handle gripped in his left hand at the lower edge. It is a big, sunburnt, good-natured face of thirty-two, ruddy brown, with round light brown eyes, thick sandy brows, a blunt nose, a wide gentle mouth, round freckled cheeks, ears that stick out a little, and eye corners that crease deeply as the slow smile arrives. Hair: sandy brown, short and bristly, with wheat chaff in it. Body: big, thick-armed and calm. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe cut short and sturdy at the sleeve for work, soaked darker at the hem, with a rope belt holding a small wooden water flask and old yellow plough-grease marking the right thigh. Hands and objects: a hand resting on a plough handle, the strong wrists tanned several shades darker than the forearms; earth on his hands; a faint green-gold dust in the air. Background: golden wheat stretching to a line of dark hills, a single ox harnessed to a plough at the field's edge, a few white clouds in a pale blue sky. Light: warm afternoon sun from the upper left. Expression: content and diligent, slow, an unhurried, delighted smile arriving at its own pace.

people.imagined: On the river-mouth ice, the best fighter on it, with a hoarfrost-white patch in his left eyebrow. He has just let someone else wear his fur, and does not regret it.
people.subject: The moment: standing on river ice at the mouth, he glances back over his shoulder with a hard, assessing look, breath steaming; he has just let someone else wear his fur, and does not regret it. Face: most important, a hoarfrost-white patch in his left eyebrow, snowy against the black hair, glittering like salt, and a thick fur collar of the river-mouth watch at his throat. It is a lean, hard, handsome face of thirty-six, wind-chapped brown, with red-chapped cheeks, narrow dark eyes, a straight nose with a thin white line of old frostbite at the tip, and a firm mouth. Hair: black, tied back in a tight tail. Body: lean, springy and balanced. Clothing: a green-grey hemp robe of good cloth, stiff with frost at the hem, under a heavy grey fur-collared coat, the collar thick and tied with a leather cord, a Cold Ford Hall blue-green sash with its ends tucked, and leather wrist guards strapped over the sleeves. Hands and objects: a short iron-shod ice spike in one hand; his breath hangs in the air as a white plume; a faint blue frost shimmer round the spike. Background: a wide frozen river mouth in pale blue-white, a few wooden watch posts, a dark thread of open water in the middle distance under a low sky. Light: cold bright light from the upper left. Expression: warlike and loyal, callous, a hard, level, assessing stare, the best fighter on the ice.

people.imagined: A ferryman's daughter on the river mouth, a small dry cough hidden in her sleeve, carrying a letter she will not read.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a ferry landing, she coughs very softly into her sleeve and hides it, looking up steadily. Face, most important: her sleeve held against her mouth, and a sealed letter tucked in her other hand without a writing mark. A small, plain, kind face of thirty-three; pale skin; shadowed grey-brown eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a modest mouth. Her cheeks have a slight hectic flush, her lips are dry and a little cracked, and a strand of hair is stuck damp to her temple. Hair: black, in a plain low knot with a river-reed pin. Body: small, thin, upright. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe, a ferry-woman's oiled short cape, a pale blue Cold Ford sash; damp hem. The oiled sea-cape over the robe is stiff and glossy and beaded with water, the pale blue sash is tied in a flat ferry knot, and a leather mail pouch hangs across her chest; one sleeve is darker where she has coughed into it. Hands: one holds her sleeve to her lips, the other a folded paper. Background: a blurred river mouth with a flat ferry, grey sky. Behind her a flat-bottomed ferry is moored against a plank landing, a pole stands upright in the water, and the far bank is a pale smudge in drizzling grey light. Light: grey diffused light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue water hint. Expression: a steady, careful look with a hidden small cough tightening the lips, honest eyes lifted.

people.imagined: A one-time thief in the marten yard, holding a pup that scratched her wrist; a fresh red line is always on it. She names every pup and cries when they're sold.
people.subject: The moment: cradling a small marten pup against her chest, looking down at it with soft eyes as it grips her wrist; she names every pup and cries when they are sold. Face: most important, a fresh red claw scratch on the back of her wrist, and the sleek brown marten pup with a cream bib held against her. It is a quick, pointed, freckled face of thirty-two, olive, with large dark eyes with a gleam in them, long dark lashes, thin arched brows, a small nose, a small old scar nicking the upper lip and a gentle smile. Hair: dark brown, cut short and uneven, with a green cord. Body: lithe and small. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with the sleeves rolled with a neat band of green cloth, a marten-brown fur trim at the collar with a few hairs clinging to it, and a scratched leather glove on the other hand. Hands and objects: the pup in one arm, its claws hooked into the cuff, the scratched wrist visible; a faint green-gold hint of warmth. Background: rows of wooden hutches with straw, small brown shapes of martens peering from holes, a pine fence. Light: warm yellow light from the upper left. Expression: compassionate and gregarious, tender, a soft, absorbed smile that is wholly for the pup.

people.imagined: The steward of the spirit-wood stores sniffs every lamp that passes, rescued as a child from a burning resin store. He stands at the door of the sheds and will not let a flame in.
people.subject: The moment: at the door of a wood shed he sniffs the air toward a passing lamp, nostrils flared, alarmed, holding out a flat hand to stop it; as a child he was rescued from a burning resin store. Face: most important, nostrils flared in mid-sniff, and a raised flat hand warning off a lamp. It is a pinched, lined, anxious face of about thirty-eight, pale, with wide watchful red-rimmed brown eyes, thin pale brows, a long thin nose, a tight mouth and a thin old burn mark on the left jaw. Hair: thin black with early grey, tied in a short knot. Body: lean and tense. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe buttoned to the throat, wet cloth wrapped round the cuffs against sparks, a thick brown apron fire-proofed with clay, a small iron bucket hanging from the belt and leather gloves tucked in his sash. Hands and objects: one hand raised flat in refusal; a faint green-brown resin haze in the air. Background: a dark shed filled with tall stacks of cut spirit-wood logs, each bound with grey rope, sand buckets lined along the wall, a lantern glow beyond the door held far away. Light: cool dim light from the upper left. Expression: cautious and diligent, a paranoid, watchful tension in the pinched mouth and the wide eyes, the look of a man who does not trust a flame.

people.imagined: The envoy's letter-writer, sitting so straight a ruler looks bent beside her, brush poised in a beautiful hand.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at a writing desk with perfectly vertical posture, brush lifted, she looks up with courteous calm. Face, most important: a perfectly straight spine and head carriage in an upright seated pose, and a brush held lightly in a fine hand. A composed, oval, honest face of forty; pale gold skin; calm dark eyes; level brows; a straight nose; a small even smile. Her brows are thin and perfectly level, her skin is smooth without a line, and her lips are slightly pursed in concentration. Hair: black, in a flawless smooth coil with a jade pin. Body: slim, absolutely upright. Clothing: a clean, finely pressed green-grey hemp robe with a pale green silk collar, narrow sleeves with no creases, a pale blue sash. The robe has not a crease at any point, its pale green silk collar is smooth as paper, the narrow sleeves are bound with silver-grey cord at the wrist, and a flat jade pendant hangs from the sash; a small ink stone lies on the desk. Hands: a brush over a blank sheet, ink stone beside. Background: a blurred window of paper. Behind her a latticed paper window glows pale, a tall vase holds a single pine branch, and a neat stack of folded letters waits on the table. Light: soft even light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-green hint. Expression: a courteous, composed face with calm, level eyes and a quiet, polite mouth.

people.imagined: At dawn he walks the array's stones, tapping each with his ring, listening for the one that hums wrong.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn among standing stones he leans in and taps a pale stone with a thick bronze ring, head tilted to listen for the one that hums wrong. Face: most important, a heavy bronze ring on his right hand tapping the stone, and an ear turned toward it. It is a broad, trusting, square face of thirty-five, light brown, with patient dark eyes, thick bushy black brows, a blunt nose, a calm mouth, a broad jaw stubbled with stone dust, and deep forehead lines from long squinting at small marks. Hair: black, in a short tied knot, a bit of stone dust in it. Body: stocky and steady. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe hitched at the sash for walking with the sleeves tied, a mason's grey apron chalk-marked across the front, a green array-runner's band wound twice round the waist, and a coil of knotted cord at the belt. Hands and objects: tapping the stone with the wide plain bronze ring, dented from use; a faint ripple in the air like a green hum. Background: a line of knee-high standing stones, each carved with a small groove, receding along a dew-wet slope in grey dawn mist. Light: pale pearl-grey dawn light from the upper left before sunrise. Expression: diligent and calm, trusting, the patient, listening face of a man who has all the time the stones need.

people.imagined: The mica-grinder with glitter on her cheekbones and sleeves, clumsy with wood and good with stone, patient at the quern.
people.subject: The moment: at a stone quern, she looks up with glitter on her face, patient and stubborn. Face, most important: glittering mica dust dusting her cheekbones and the bridge of her nose like silver freckles, and sleeves sparkling. A broad, plain, steady face of thirty-five; tan skin; dark patient eyes; heavy straight brows; a wide nose; a firm mouth. Silver mica flecks even her eyelashes, her skin is warm brown with a faint sheen, and a small crease sits between her thick brows. Hair: black, in a thick braid wrapped around her head, silvery with dust. Body: broad, short, strong forearms. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe, sleeves rolled and shimmering with mica, a dark leather apron. Her robe sleeves are rolled above muscular forearms glittering with dust, a heavy dark leather apron hangs from neck to knee with a pocket of sifted powder, and a small cloth bag of mica hangs at her belt, its seams sparkling. Hands: a small stone pestle held over a quern of pale flakes. Background: a blurred workshop with shelves of silver powder jars. Behind her a workbench holds stone querns of various sizes, small jars of powder in silver, pale gold and grey, and a window throws a bright square across the glittering floor. Light: bright light from the upper left glinting off the dust. Qi: a faint pale silver-green sparkle. Expression: a patient, stubborn look with a small closed smile, glitter sparkling on the cheekbones.

people.imagined: A child-faced healer on a grown frame, practising his old hall's method, wide-eyed and earnest, a healer's calm in a round face.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling beside a patient with two fingers laid lightly on a wrist, he looks up with earnest big eyes, practising his old hall's method. Face: most important, a round child's face, with soft plump cheeks and no lines, set on a grown man's broad shoulders and long arms, plainly mismatched. He appears about eighteen in body but with a baby-smooth round face, pink, with dimples, large clear wet-bright brown eyes, soft light brows, a button nose, a small honest mouth, and a heavy grown jaw beneath that contrasts strikingly. Hair: soft brown, short and fluffy. Body: tall, broad-shouldered and gangly. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe cut generously for his tall frame, the healing house's pale green collar sitting slightly crooked as if dressed by someone else, the sleeves tied with cord, and a herb pouch at his belt stitched with a child's stitches. Hands and objects: two fingers on a patient's wrist; a faint warm green glow at the fingertips. Background: a healing room with a pallet bed holding a patient under a quilt, jars of herbs hanging from beams, a small oil lamp in a wall niche. Light: soft warm light from the upper left. Expression: honest and compassionate, stubborn, a calm, wide-eyed healer's patience in a round face.

people.imagined: A small woman at the tea terrace, her deep slow voice surprising for her size; she pours the head's tea slowly.
people.subject: The moment: pouring tea from a small clay pot at the tea terrace, she says something slowly in a surprisingly low voice, calm; she pours the head's tea unhurried. Face: most important, a very small, slight woman with a calm broad forehead, steam rising from the pot she pours, and a deep, slow, unhurried manner. It is a small, round, serene face of thirty-five, light brown, with half-lidded dark eyes, fine lines at the corners of the sleepy eyes, thin brows, a small nose, a small chin, a gentle closed smile and a faint dusting of green tea-leaf on one cheek. Hair: black, in a low tail wrapped in a tea-green cloth. Body: tiny, slender and steady, with tiny hands. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with the sleeves tied up with cord, a tea-leaf green apron with a pocket of dried leaves, and a small bamboo whisk hanging from the belt. Hands and objects: a small clay teapot, dark with years of brewing, pouring into a cup; a faint green steam haze. Background: rows of dark glossy tea bushes climbing a terrace in curving lines, soft mist hanging between them. Light: soft misty light from the upper left. Expression: calm and content, temperate, an unhurried, sleepy gentleness behind which nothing is rushed.

people.imagined: She puts on a scowl for company, white wax on her sleeves, regretting the Cliff Hall every winter and admitting it to one friend.
people.subject: The moment: glaring at the viewer with a deliberate, performed scowl, the corner of her mouth twitching to give it away; she regrets the Cliff Hall every winter and admits it to one friend. Face: most important, a deliberate fierce scowl, brows drawn hard together, with a twitch of a smile at one corner. It is a sturdy, freckled, rosy face of thirty, fair, with bright hazel eyes, thick brown brows, a short nose, a full mouth, nostrils flaring a little, and scowl lines fresh and deliberate rather than deep. Hair: light brown, in a thick short plait tied with a white wax-cloth ribbon. Body: sturdy and square, arms folded. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, neatly kept and clean, with white wax flecks spotting both cuffs like paint and a leather belt pulled tight. Hands and objects: arms crossed over the chest, the wax-flecked cuffs showing; a faint pale green sheen at the fingertips. Background: a grey rock ridge with a crooked pine, a stone wall, a pale sky heavy with winter. Light: cold grey light from the upper left. Expression: stubborn and brave, impatient, a performed fierceness with a secret softness at the corner of the mouth.

people.imagined: He has built a second nine-square field in the forest for forty years and is nearly done. A stoop from the low branches.
people.subject: The moment: standing among tree trunks, he looks up from under a low branch with quiet satisfaction at a nearly finished field. Face, most important: a deep forward stoop of the shoulders and neck, head tipped under a low branch, and a walnut-brown weathered face. Age appearing about sixty-two; deep lines; patient brown eyes; grey bushy brows; a blunt nose; a calm mouth. His forehead has a permanent pink line where branches have struck it, his neck is thick and bent forward, and his eyes are deep-set with a tired gentleness. Hair: grey, tied in a knot, with a walnut leaf. Body: bent, strong, long arms. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with damp hem, a woven bark belt, a farmer's wide straw hat hanging at his back. The robe's shoulders are rubbed pale from branches and the hem is dark with leaf-mould, a woven bark belt holds a small mallet, the wide hat on his back is stitched with bark strips, and his hands are scarred and strong. Hands: one hand holding a small wooden stake marker. Background: a forest clearing with a nine-square plot of tilled earth, blurred. Behind him a forest clearing opens onto a tilled square divided into nine plots by low stone borders, sunbeams striping the soil between tall walnut trunks. Light: dappled green light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown-green earth hint. Expression: a quiet, satisfied smile with a stubborn set to the jaw and tired, content eyes looking up from the low branch.

people.imagined: The only man in the Hall of Rules with a pine-cut collar, writing a judgment in one book and a second book of the ones he thinks were wrong.
people.subject: The moment: at a clerk's desk, he looks up from two books, one open and one hidden half under his arm, careful and just. Face, most important: a collar cut in a pine-palace style, wider and with a deep V at the throat unlike the closed collars around him, and a second book pressed under his arm. A neat, lean, serious face of thirty-eight; pale skin; steady dark eyes; level brows; a thin straight nose; a closed mouth. His eyes have the steady dark look of a man who weighs everything, his lips are set precisely level, and ink dots his right cheekbone. Hair: black, tied up with a plain wooden pin. Body: slim, upright. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe cut with the pine-palace collar, a plain dark sash, ink-black cuffs. The robe's collar has the deep V of the pine country, edged in a thin dark line, in startling contrast with the closed collars around him; the sash is plain dark cotton, the cuffs ink-stained, and a second small book is bound with green cord. Hands: a brush in one hand, the book under the other arm. Background: a blurred hall with a lacquered rack of bamboo slips, no writing. Behind him lacquered racks of bamboo slips line the hall, a brass lamp hangs on a chain, and polished dark floorboards shine in the light. Light: cool even light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green hint. Expression: a careful, even gaze with lips pressed in thought and level, honest eyes.

people.imagined: The water-chestnut girl who followed peach petals up a stream and came back three days later, a peach-petal birthmark behind her ear.
people.subject: The moment: turning her head slightly to show a small mark behind her ear, her eyes distant and dreamy as if remembering something she cannot; she followed peach petals up a stream and came back three days later. Face: most important, a small pink peach-petal-shaped birthmark the size of a thumbnail behind her left ear, shown by her tilted head, and her faraway gaze. It is a soft, round, dreamy face of thirty-five, light brown, with wide, slightly unfocused dark eyes under long lashes, soft arched brows, a small nose, a few freckles and a half-smile. Hair: black, in a loose braid over her right shoulder, a single pink petal caught in it. Body: slender and light. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with a port-house blue-green sash knotted loosely, loose slightly-too-long sleeves, a hem perpetually damp and spotted with mud, and a fine thread of pink petals caught in the weave of the collar. Hands and objects: a single pink peach petal held between two fingers; a faint blue water shimmer around it. Background: a clear stream curling through green moss under a bank of peach trees heavy with blossom, petals drifting on the water in pink rafts. Light: soft pink-gold light from the upper left. Expression: a gentle, drifting half-smile with distant, dreamy eyes, as if lost mid-memory.

people.imagined: Argues at dinner with her grandfather about an array, with his quick, bent walk caught in her stance as she leans forward.
people.subject: The moment: leaning forward across a dinner table, she argues with a raised finger and an eager grin, her shoulders bent in her grandfather's quick forward-leaning way. Face, most important: a sharp forward lean with one shoulder dropped like an old man's quick, bent walk, and an eager open face. A lively, angular face of thirty; tan skin; bright dark eyes; strong arched brows; a straight nose; a wide grin. Her cheeks are lean, her brows mobile and expressive, a small scar by her chin, and a quick bright light sits in her eyes. Hair: black, in a high tail with a green cord. Body: lean, forward-bent, restless. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with a green array-hall sash and chalky cuffs. The robe's sleeves are chalk-white at the cuffs, the green array-hall sash is knotted tight and slung low, and her shoulders have the same forward lean as the old man's, her elbow planted on the table. Hands: one hand raised with a finger, the other holding chopsticks. Background: a blurred lamp-lit dining room. Behind her a low round table crowded with bowls and dishes, a shared pot steaming, and a lamp casting amber light across a plain wall. Light: warm lamp light from the lower left. Qi: a faint green shimmer. Expression: an eager grin with bright eyes and a raised brow, leaning in to press her point.

people.imagined: In the pill shop, he turns a jade thumb ring whenever he lies, selling cheap pills as the Healing House's stock.
people.subject: The moment: standing behind a shop counter, smiling smoothly while his thumb turns a jade ring on the other hand, selling cheap pills as the Healing House's stock. Face: most important, a thick pale-green jade ring turned around the thumb with the other hand, held visible at the chest, and a smooth, friendly smile. It is a round, ruddy, handsome face of forty with shrewd brown eyes, neat brows, a short nose, a wide easy smile with well-worn creases, plump cheeks shaved to a blue-ish gloss, and a thin carefully trimmed moustache. Hair: black, oiled, in a topknot with a green silk ribbon. Body: plump and comfortable. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with a silk-edged collar and a green merchant's over-vest embroidered at the hem with tiny coins, and a row of tiny blank pill-jar tags hanging from the belt. Hands and objects: one hand turning the jade ring, the thumb moving over it whenever he lies; a faint green gleam on the jade. Background: shelves of small lacquered pill jars in red and black, a brass scale on the counter, a hanging lantern. Light: warm yellow lamplight from the upper left. Expression: pragmatic and gregarious, a greedy ease behind the smile, the glow of a man who has just sold something for more than it is worth.

people.imagined: The head's oldest disciple, happy at Trúc Cơ on the peak where the water ends, wind-grey hair to his waist.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a high windy peak where the water ends, his long grey hair streaming sideways, a contented smile as he looks out, happy at Trúc Cơ. Face: most important, very long wind-grey hair streaming out to one side down to his waist. It is a lean, brown, serene face of about fifty-five, lined by wind and sun, with bright content unhurried dark eyes, long brows white as frost, a long nose and a quiet smile. Hair: silver-grey and loose, combed back by the wind. Body: thin, straight and relaxed. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe washed soft and pale and carefully mended in several shades of green, a plain cord belt, and straw sandals; the faded colour is the choice of an old disciple who prefers it so. Hands and objects: one hand rests on a walking staff, a bare grey branch polished by use; a faint pale blue wind-line in the air. Background: a bare high peak dropping away into cloud, a few small birds wheeling far below, thin cold sunlight lighting a streak of rock. Light: bright clear light from the upper left. Expression: content and calm, reclusive, the serene half-smile of a man who has nothing left to want from the view.

people.imagined: The granary clerk's daughter with mud to her elbows, digging a plot of her own beside the Heir's Garden, her city accent in her stubborn jaw.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a freshly dug plot, she plants a spade in the earth and lifts her chin stubbornly. Face, most important: mud to both elbows, thick and wet on bare forearms held in front, and a firm lifted chin. A broad, short-statured, round-faced girl of nineteen; tanned skin with a dirt streak on the cheek; determined dark eyes; thick brows; a snub nose; a tight mouth. Her cheeks are round and freckled under the mud, her eyebrows are thick, and her upper lip is set stubbornly over a slightly prominent chin. Hair: black, in a bun with a green rag. Body: short, broad, strong. Clothing: a clean-ish green-grey hemp robe of the outer gate, a pale grey sash, sleeves pushed up. The robe is damp and dark with mud to the knees, a pale grey outer-gate sash is wound twice round her waist, her sleeves are pushed to the shoulder, and a battered pair of cloth shoes shows at the lower edge. Hands: both on the spade handle. Background: a blurred hillside with a fresh square plot, green sprouts. Behind her a freshly dug square of dark earth lies next to a larger garden, a few green seedlings poking up and a wooden stake driven in at each corner. Light: bright daylight from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown earth haze. Expression: a stubborn lifted chin with a set mouth and fierce, determined eyes, a smear of mud on her cheek.

people.imagined: The handsome outer disciple who learns everyone's name on the first day, smiling easily, with a pine-palace man's eye behind the smile.
people.subject: The moment: leaning in with a warm easy smile, as if about to greet the viewer by name. Face, most important: a very handsome, open face with a bright easy smile and warm eyes that hold the viewer's gaze a beat too long. Age twenty-four; smooth fair skin; light amber-brown eyes; arched fine brows; a straight nose; a charming smile with white teeth. His teeth are white and even, his eyes warm amber with long lashes, and a small dimple appears in his left cheek when he smiles. Hair: black, in a tidy topknot with a green silk cord. Body: tall, easy, well-proportioned. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe of the outer gate with a pine-green silk lining visible at the cuff, a pale grey sash. The outer-gate robe is perfectly fitted and cleaner than most, its pale grey sash tied in a neat flat knot, and a flash of pine-green silk lining shows at the cuff; a small jade bead hangs from the sash. Hands: one extended in a greeting. Background: a blurred outer-gate courtyard with other students. Behind him an open courtyard with whitewashed walls and a few students chatting in small groups, a persimmon tree heavy with orange fruit, and a bright sky. Light: bright friendly light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green shimmer. Expression: a warm, easy smile with friendly eyes that take the viewer in quickly, a watchful gleam behind the charm.

people.imagined: The warden's son would rather fish than fight and has not told his father; a fish scale sticks to his sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a pier with a fishing line, he glances sideways at the viewer with a small guilty grin. Face, most important: a single silvery fish scale stuck to his sleeve, large and glinting, and a fishing line held loosely. A mild, sun-browned, easygoing face of twenty-two; brown skin; soft dark eyes; light brows; a snub nose; a lazy half-smile. His nose is peeling slightly from sun, there is a smear of river mud on one cheek, and his eyes crinkle with easy guilt. Hair: black, tousled, tied with a bit of twine. Body: lanky, relaxed, slouching. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with a damp hem, a blue Cold Ford sash worn loose. The robe is loosely belted, damp at the hem, the blue sash hangs untied, and a small wicker creel is slung over his shoulder with a silvery fish tail peeping out; a fine thread of fishing line is wrapped round his wrist. Hands: a bamboo fishing rod in both hands. Background: a blurred river mouth with moored boats. Behind him a wooden pier juts into a calm river mouth, small boats are tied along it, and reed-beds sway in the evening breeze. Light: warm light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue water shimmer. Expression: a small guilty grin with a sideways glance and a flush at the ears, the face loose and content.

people.imagined: On the oyster-bed pier, she stares at the sky where the sea eagles wheel, jaw set, her sister's loss in her eyes. She has not yet been allowed to kill one.
people.subject: The moment: on a plank pier above oyster beds she stares upward at a hunting sea eagle, jaw clenched, one hand on a barbed spear, her sister's loss in her eyes; she has not yet been allowed to kill one. Face: most important, a long white scar from an eagle's talon, three fine parallel lines, running along her left jaw from ear to chin, clear against tanned skin. It is a hard, handsome, narrow face of thirty-four with deep-set dark eyes, straight heavy brows, a sharp nose and a thin tight mouth, the lips chapped by salt wind. Hair: black, cut chin-length and straight, wind-blown. Body: lean, wiry and tense. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with the sleeves rolled and stiff with salt at the cuffs, an oiled dark leather sea-cape buckled at the throat with a bone toggle, and a blue-green port-house sash with its ends knotted twice. Hands and objects: a barbed oyster-bed spear held upright, its lanyard held by leather wrist-straps; a faint blue water haze. Background: grey sea, wet black oyster-bed posts marching out into grey-green shallows, a rack of oyster baskets on the pier, and a pale sky slashed by two dark wheeling birds. Light: hard overcast light from the upper left. Expression: a clenched jaw and a cold, burning stare turned skyward, the mouth hard and thin.

people.imagined: The Cliff Hall's cook of seventy years holds his ladle like a sceptre over the cauldron, deciding the day's salt by his mood.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a great iron cauldron, he lifts a long wooden ladle like a sceptre and regards the viewer with grand self-importance. Face, most important: a big wooden ladle held upright like a royal sceptre in front of him, and a round red-cheeked, bushy-browed face. Age appearing about fifty-eight; ruddy skin; small bright black eyes; thick grey brows; a bulbous nose; a wide pursed mouth. His cheeks are broken with tiny red veins, his nose is round and shiny, and his bushy brows tilt upward like a wizard's. Hair: thin white, a cloth cap pushed back. Body: short, round-bellied, plump hands. Clothing: a clean white cook's apron over a plain brown hemp tunic, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a cloth sweat-rag round the neck. The apron is stiff with flour and splashed with soup, the brown tunic has the left sleeve rolled higher than the right, a cloth sweat-rag is knotted round his neck, and a ring of keys hangs at his belt; the ladle's long handle is dark with years of grease. Hands: the ladle in one fist, the other holding a pinch of salt aloft. Background: a steamy kitchen with hanging pots. Behind him a huge black iron cauldron steams on a brick hearth, strings of dried peppers and pots hang from the beams, and a stack of salt jars stands in the corner. Light: warm steam-lit light from the lower left. Qi: a faint grey-gold hint. Expression: a grand, self-important look with lifted chin and heavy lids, a pompous half-smile in the beard.

people.imagined: The herd boy of the outer gate, boots caked in dung, sitting beside his old grandfather's feet for his last spring.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a log with his boots stuck out in front, he grins and tips his head toward an unseen old man beside him. Face, most important: heavy boots thickly caked with dried dung, stretched out in the foreground, and a sunburnt cheerful face. A wide, easy face of eighteen; brown skin; bright brown eyes; messy dark brows; a flat nose; a loose grin. His nose is peeling and freckled, his ears are big, and a dimple shows on one cheek when he grins. Hair: black, shaggy and sun-streaked. Body: stocky, relaxed, slouched. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe, hem damp, grey sash worn loose; a short herder's leather vest. The robe's hem is spattered with mud and grass, the grey sash is tied in a lazy loop, his short leather vest is scuffed and sweat-dark, and the boots are caked to the ankle with brown dung dried pale at the edges. Hands: a bamboo switch across his knees. Background: a blurred pasture with grazing cattle. Behind him green pasture rolls to a line of willows, a few brown and white cattle graze with swishing tails, and a thin plume of dust hangs in the warm air. Light: warm light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-gold dust. Expression: a wide, lazy grin with a loose jaw and warm eyes turned toward the old man.

people.imagined: A rope-maker's son lifts his chin hopefully at an elder who passes, rope-braid in hand, wanting the inner gate.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a drying frame, he lifts his chin with a hopeful, over-eager look at a passing elder. Face, most important: a chin lifted very high, hopeful and rigid, and a rope of braided herb-line looped round one forearm. A thin, eager face of twenty-one; sallow skin; bright anxious eyes; thin brows raised high; a long nose; a tight eager smile. His jaw is thin and shaved close, his eyebrows are drawn so high they wrinkle his forehead, and tiny beads of sweat stand at his temple. Hair: black, in a neat knot with a green cord. Body: thin, tense, very straight. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe, grey sash tied in a tight perfect knot, sleeves tied back. The robe is ironed flat, the grey sash tied in an exact knot with ends of equal length, a small hemp coil is hooked at the belt, and callus-split fingers grip the loop of rope; a petition-box on a cord hangs at his chest. Hands: both holding a loop of braided drying-line. Background: lines of drying herbs hung in rows, blurred. Behind him long lines of herbs hang drying from bamboo frames in rows, the green-grey of leaves and pale roots swaying, with a tiled roof overhead. Light: bright light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green hint. Expression: a hopeful, over-eager look with raised brows and a smile a little too bright to be natural.

people.imagined: She lacquers red pill boxes in a quiet shed, her hands stained red to the wrist and never itching.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a lacquering bench, she holds up a freshly lacquered red box, patient and pleased. Face, most important: both hands stained deep lacquer-red up to the wrist, and a glossy scarlet pill box held up between them. A soft, broad, quiet face of twenty-six; light brown skin; calm dark eyes; thin soft brows; a small nose; a modest smile. Her cheeks are smooth, a tiny red lacquer speck sits near her eye, and her eyelids are lowered with care. Hair: black, in a low plait with a red cloth tie. Body: small, steady. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe, a dark wax-cloth apron, sleeves tied up; the grey outer-gate sash. The wax-cloth apron is spotted red and black, her sleeves are tied up with string, the grey sash is neatly knotted, and she wears flat cloth shoes; the stained hands are the same warm red as the boxes. Hands: the red-stained hands holding the lacquered box. Background: a blurred shed with rows of drying red boxes. Behind her are long shelves with rows of drying red boxes, a small brazier, and a shaft of pale light from a high window. Light: soft warm light from the upper left. Qi: a faint warm green hint. Expression: a calm, pleased face with a soft smile and patient, lowered eyes on the lacquer.

people.imagined: The fire-tender, charcoal smell in every season, hesitates at the furnace door, having told what he saw for a place at the second cauldron.
people.subject: The moment: crouching at a furnace mouth with a poker, he glances back over his shoulder with a guarded, uneasy look, having told what he saw for a place at the second cauldron. Face: most important, soot-darkened skin and a charcoal-black smear across his nose, and a long iron poker held up. It is a lean, angular, honest-looking face of twenty-eight, tanned, with wary dark eyes whose whites are red from smoke, thick straight brows, a long nose and a tight mouth; the soot is deepest in the creases by the eyes and mouth and the eyelashes are singed short. Hair: black and short, dusted grey with ash. Body: wiry and hunched. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with the sleeves bound with cord at the elbow, a leather apron scorched at the hem, and a damp cloth tied round his neck; his boots are black with ash. Hands and objects: a long iron poker held at the furnace, its end glowing dull orange; a faint green fire hint on it. Background: the furnace door gaping with green flame, a row of cauldrons in silhouette, sparks of pale green drifting upward. Light: green furnace glow from the lower left. Expression: uneasy and cautious, faithless, a guarded, sidelong look with the smell of charcoal in every season.

people.imagined: A poria-digger's girl, newly a second disciple, smiling openly, unaware that a rival watches her.
people.subject: The moment: holding up a pale knobbly poria root in both hands with a bright open smile, newly a second disciple and unaware that a rival watches her. Face: most important, a small pale crescent scar on the point of her chin, and a large pale tuber held up in both hands. It is a round, fresh, friendly face of twenty-three, warm brown, with flushed round cheeks, bright sparkling hazel eyes, thick soft brows, a small nose and a wide smile. Hair: brown, in a long braid tied with a green ribbon. Body: sturdy and bouncy. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with an inner-gate green silk collar spotted with soil, a herb-digger's brown apron with a small trowel in its pocket, and mud-crusted cuffs. Hands and objects: the root held high; a faint green sparkle on it. Her fingers are earthy to the knuckle and her nails dark with soil. Background: an old pine forest sloping upward, fallen needles golden on the ground, a dug hole and a small pile of earth nearby, shafts of sun between the trunks. Light: bright morning light from the upper left. The sun makes a bright spot on the pale root. Expression: an open, delighted smile with wide, bright eyes and nothing held back.

people.imagined: A kelp-gatherer's son, a runner who gives his rations away, belt wrapped twice round a thin waist, holding out his last rice cake.
people.subject: The moment: halting mid-run, he holds out a rice cake to the viewer with a generous grin, the last of his rations. Face: most important, a belt of plain rope wrapped twice round an extremely thin waist and cinched tight, and the pale rice cake offered. It is a thin, bright, honest face of thirty, brown skin stretched over high cheekbones, with warm dark eyes in deep hollows, thick brows, a wide nose, chapped lips and a generous grin. Hair: black, tied with a green cord, wind-tousled. Body: very thin, tall and wiry. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe cut short for running, bunching at the rope belt, a blue port-house sash, and a flat nearly empty messenger's pouch at the hip; scuffed sandals. Hands and objects: a pale rice cake held out in one hand; a faint blue-green water hint in the air. The rice cake is still warm and wrapped in a corner of green leaf. Background: a harbour road along a sea wall, gulls wheeling over drying nets, stacked kelp racks to one side. Light: bright sea light from the upper left. The salt light makes his thin cheeks glow. Expression: generous and gregarious, honest, an open, giving grin that does not notice its own hunger.

people.imagined: A new outer disciple who cannot sit still through a lesson, sticky resin on her fingers, fidgeting as her jar sits on a shelf.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a lesson she fidgets, picking at her sticky fingers and glancing at the door, while her jar sits on a shelf. Face: most important, golden amber resin sticky on her fingertips, strings of it stretching between finger and thumb, and a restless bright face. It is a pert, round, bright face of nineteen, olive, with rosy cheeks, sparkling dark eyes that dart to the door, quick arched brows, a snub nose, a small smear of resin glinting on the chin and a restless half-smile. Hair: black, in two short buns, a pine needle stuck in one. Body: small and wriggling. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with long sleeves that hang over her fingers and are stuck at the cuffs with resin, a grey sash half untied, and a tiny jar on a cord at her neck. Hands and objects: sticky amber threads between her fingers; a faint pale green tint in the resin. Background: a lesson hall with rows of cushions, the blurred figure of an old teacher at the front, light slanting through a wooden lattice. Light: soft light from the upper left, gold on the resin. Expression: bored and fickle, gregarious, a restless, bright impatience that cannot wait for the lesson to end.

people.imagined: A stonecutter's son has made peace with the outer gate; he lays terrace walls, his fingertips cut flat by stone.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a half-built wall, he sets a stone with calm certainty and looks up with a peaceable face. Face, most important: fingertips worn flat and blunt by stone, held on a pale stone block, and a heavy sunburnt face. A broad, square, quiet face of thirty-two; brown skin; patient dark eyes; thick brows; a flat nose; a closed mouth. His knuckles are scarred, his eyebrows thick with stone dust, and his face has the calm of a man who has stopped arguing with the world. Hair: black, cropped short, grey with stone dust. Body: heavy, broad, solid. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe, leather knee pads, a grey sash, sleeves rolled. The knee pads are tied over the robe's dusty knees, the sleeves are rolled above thick forearms, a plumb-line hangs from his belt, and the grey sash is stiff with lime. Hands: both on a stone. Background: a terrace wall of fitted grey stone, green fields beyond. Behind him a terraced wall of fitted grey stone steps up a hillside, with green rice-shoots on the upper level and tools laid neatly by the wall. Light: bright light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown earth haze. Expression: a peaceful, steady face with calm eyes and a stubborn, quiet set to the mouth.

people.imagined: A raftsman on a log raft in autumn, bow-legged balanced stance as it shoots the rapids with spirit wood.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a raft of logs in autumn as it shoots the rapids with spirit wood, legs wide apart and bowed, steering with a long pole. Face: most important, a deeply bow-legged wide stance on a moving raft of logs, and a long steering pole. It is a tanned, lined, cheerful face of twenty-nine, ruddy brown and windburned, with sharp light brown eyes crinkled from spray, thick brows with a few drops hanging on them, a hooked nose and a broad grin. Hair: black, tied with a cord, wet with spray. Body: short, strong and broad-chested. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe cut short at the knee and soaked, a leather vest, a blue river sash tied tight, bare calves scratched from bark, and hobnailed boots gripping the logs. Hands and objects: a long wooden pole held in both hands; a faint blue-green spray in the air. His knuckles are white on the pole and his boots dig into the wet bark. Background: a rushing river tumbling between steep forested banks, more logs bobbing in the froth, mist rising from the rapids. Light: bright light from the upper left, glittering on the spray. The spray throws small bright rainbows round his head. Expression: brave and honest, gregarious, a wide, exhilarated grin that is perfectly at home on a moving floor.

people.imagined: The newest outer disciple, seventeen, checks her life tree before breakfast; a leaf from it is pinned in her braid.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a thin sapling at dawn, one hand lightly holding its top, checking her life tree anxiously before breakfast. Face: most important, a small bright green leaf from her life tree pinned in a thin braid, and a hand lightly holding a sapling's top. It is a thin, young, trusting face of seventeen, light brown, with wide worried brown eyes, thin brows, a small nose, a hopeful mouth with the upper lip trembling very slightly, and cheeks pink from the early cold. Hair: black, in a thin plait that hangs over one shoulder. Body: slight and slim. Clothing: a clean, new, slightly stiff green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with sleeves a thumb too long, a grey sash neatly tied, and a small cloth bag of fertilizer at her belt. Hands and objects: one hand on the tiny tree; a faint pale green tint around its leaves. Background: a hillside of saplings each tied with a coloured cord, cold white mist at their feet, a pink streak of dawn above. Light: soft pink dawn light from the upper left. Expression: trusting and diligent, anxious, the wide, hopeful look of a girl who is afraid her tree has not grown.

people.imagined: A field worker with a broad nose burnt red by spring sun, writing her cousin's rows in a ledger as her own, smiling.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a field, wiping her brow with a sleeve, smiling affably while a brush is tucked behind her ear; she is writing her cousin's rows in her own ledger. Face: most important, a broad nose burnt bright red by the sun, peeling a little, in a round brown face. She is twenty-five, with bright quick eyes, thick sun-bleached brows, a wide smile, and a bead of sweat running down her temple. Hair: black, in a bun under a straw hat. Body: sturdy and broad-shouldered. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with the sleeves rolled to the shoulder, a damp grey sash, and a wide straw hat stained at the band; a small ledger bound in cord tucked into her belt. Hands and objects: one hand wipes her forehead, the other holds a hoe, the forearms muscular and tanned; a faint brown-green tint in the air. The brush behind her ear is dark at the tip with fresh ink. Background: a green wheat field stretching under bright sun, a row of scarecrows at the edge, pale butterflies hovering over the stalks. Light: bright spring sun from the upper left. Gold sun lights the peeling red nose and the bead of sweat. Expression: friendly and ambitious, an affable, deceitful smile that gives nothing away about the ledger.

people.imagined: The copyist copies a forbidden recipe into his own book first; his fingertips are dyed grey from old paper.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a desk in the library at night, he glances up furtively, covering a second small book with his sleeve; he copies a forbidden recipe into his own book first. Face: most important, fingertips stained slate-grey from old paper, spread on the page, and a second small book half hidden under his sleeve. It is a pale, narrow, shut face of thirty-one, with hooded dark eyes, thin neat brows, a thin nose, a closed mouth, a vertical line between the brows, and the grey of old paper staining the lower lip where he has touched it. Hair: black, tied in a plain knot with a wooden pin. Body: slim and stooped. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with a crisp inner-gate green collar, ink-grey cuffs, sleeves wide enough to hide a book, and a small lamp-wick trimmer hanging from his belt. Hands and objects: grey fingertips on an old yellowed book; a faint pale green tint over the page. Background: shelves crowded with old books in yellowed covers, a lamp in a niche casting a small circle of light, dark corners full of dust. Light: dim lamp light from the lower left, leaving the rest of the room in shadow. Expression: diligent and reclusive, a deceitful stillness, the shut, careful face of a man who is hiding something under his sleeve.

people.imagined: A beekeeper's daughter, bee-sting welts like beads along her neck, stands among her spirit bees, keeping the best comb back.
people.subject: The moment: standing among humming hives, she lifts a golden honeycomb and smiles slyly. Face, most important: a row of small healed round sting welts along her neck like a string of beads, and bees crawling on her bare forearm. A round, rosy, shrewd face of twenty-seven; fair skin; clever light brown eyes; thin brows; a small nose; a slow sly smile. Her cheeks are plump and flushed, her eyes narrow with cunning and bright, and the welts on her neck show pale pink in a neat row. Hair: light brown, in a thick braid under a veiled straw hat pushed back. Body: stout, steady. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with sleeves rolled to the elbow, a thick leather apron. A net veil is pushed up onto the straw hat, the sleeves are rolled above forearms speckled with old stings, the thick leather apron is sticky with honey, and the grey outer-gate sash is tied low. Hands: a dripping golden comb. Background: blurred wooden hives, drifting bees in sun. Behind her wooden hives stand in a sunlit meadow of flowers, bees thread the air in golden streaks, and a pail of honeycomb sits by her feet. Light: warm gold light from the upper left. Qi: a faint golden shimmer. Expression: a sly, pleased smile with sidelong eyes and a lifted chin, keeping something back.

people.imagined: The crow-keeper, a feather stuck in his hair on the same side always, with crows on the fence; he has invented a death for amusement.
people.subject: The moment: with crows perched on a fence at his shoulder he leans toward the viewer to murmur a secret, eyes bright; he has invented a death for amusement. Face: most important, a black crow feather stuck upright in his hair above the left ear, and a black crow perched on his shoulder. It is a narrow, pale, clever face of twenty-four, with dark, sharp, restless eyes like a crow's, thick black brows, narrow cheeks, a thin nose, and a sly crooked smile whose lips twitch as if sharing a joke with the birds. Hair: black and untidy, standing up in tufts. Body: thin and loose. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with a grey sash hung with a pouch of grain, a second black feather tucked in the collar, and a leather pad on the shoulder, scratched by claws, where the crow sits. Hands and objects: a handful of grain held out; a faint dark-green haze in the air. Background: a weathered fence with three black crows perched on it and a fourth landing, a flat grey sky and a bare tree. Light: cool grey light from the upper left, picking out the blue sheen of the feathers. Expression: sly and fickle, reclusive, the delighted, conspiratorial look of someone who has just told a lie to a bird.

people.imagined: She reads the scriptures aloud to the field workers at night, a pressed red leaf in her cap band, calm and devout.
people.subject: The moment: sitting under a lantern she reads aloud from a scroll to field workers at night, her voice quiet, looking up gently. Face: most important, a flat pressed red maple leaf tucked into the band of her cloth cap, bright crimson against the green-grey. It is a mild, quiet, oval face of twenty-eight, pale, with soft dark eyes tired from reading by lamplight, thin brows, a small nose, and a gentle mouth whose shape shows the soft cadence of her voice. Hair: black, in a bun under a neat cloth cap tied under the chin. Body: slender and still. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with narrow sleeves tied back, a grey sash tied flat, and the pressed maple leaf vivid against the cap band. Hands and objects: a bamboo scroll, bound with a cord, held open, its strips blank to the eye; a faint green-blue hint in the air. Background: vague figures of tired field workers seated on mats, listening, a lantern glowing on a post, and fields stretching away into the dark. Light: warm lantern light from the lower left, gold on the pale cheek. Expression: humble and patient, devout, a calm, reading look that does not hurry anyone to understand.

people.imagined: The woodcutter's son sings quietly in the fields, humming even in his sleep, mouth half open.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a hoe in a field, humming softly with eyes half closed, in a daze of afternoon contentment. Face: most important, a mouth slightly open in a hum, the throat visibly moving, and a dreamy face. It is a wide, soft, easy face of thirty-three, brown, with half-lidded brown eyes, thin brows, a blunt nose, a relaxed mouth and a slack, happy jaw. Hair: black, tied loosely with straw, under a straw hat pushed back. Body: tall and loose, in a contented slouch with the weight on one hip and shoulders sagging. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe loosely belted, the hem damp, a grey sash knotted at the side, a woodcutter's callus showing on his palm. Hands and objects: both hands resting on a hoe handle; a faint green shimmer in the air. Background: a field of young green shoots glowing in afternoon haze, a faint line of hills beyond, a few swallows dipping over the crop. Light: warm light from the upper left, picking out the fine hairs on his forearms and leaving the face in warm green shade under the hat brim. Expression: content and lazy, gregarious, the loose, humming serenity of a boy who hums even in his sleep.

people.imagined: A water-carrier with a limp from the spring's steps, two jars on a pole, compassionate and calm.
people.subject: The moment: on a stone stair she steadies a yoke pole with two water pails, her weight shifted onto her good leg, carrying water from the spring with a calm face. Face: most important, a visible limp, the body tipped off-centre under the yoke, and two wooden water pails hanging from it. It is a gentle, pale, serene face of twenty-one, with clear calm eyes, level brows, a straight nose, a quiet smile and a trace of strain at the mouth with each step. Hair: black, in a long braid tied with a blue ribbon. Body: slim and tilted, the left foot turned slightly inward. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with the hem darkened by splashes, a pale blue Healing House sash tied firmly, and a folded cloth pad cushioning her shoulder under the yoke. Hands and objects: both hands holding the yoke ropes; a faint blue water shimmer around the pails. Background: mossy stone steps climbing to a spring bubbling from a rock, ferns hanging over the water, a cool green light filtering through leaves. Light: soft cool light from the upper left. Expression: compassionate and devout, calm, a quiet, unhurried patience in a face that has long since stopped minding the stair.

people.imagined: A fisher girl whose bare feet stand firm in every weather, promised the first voyage south, impatient at the quay.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a quay edge, looking out to sea with arms folded, impatient. Face, most important: bare feet planted firmly on wet planks (shown at the bottom of the frame), and a windblown determined face. A strong, tanned, freckled face of twenty-four; bright sea-grey eyes; thick brows; a short nose; a firm mouth. Her cheeks are wind-reddened, her jaw firm, and her eyes narrow against the glare. Hair: dark brown, in a thick sun-streaked braid, wind-whipped. Body: strong, compact. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe of the inner gate, sleeves rolled, a blue sash. The robe is cut short for work, the sleeves rolled, the blue sash tight, her wide brown feet bare on the wet plank; a coil of rope hangs from her belt. Hands: arms crossed. Background: a blurred harbour, grey-blue sea. Behind her a busy harbour with ships, nets and barrels, and a dark blue sea shot with white caps under a large sky. Light: bright wind-swept light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue water sparkle. She stands with feet planted wide and heels together at the quay's edge, shoulders squared like a woman about to board; the wind pulls loose strands across her cheek and the light rakes sideways, glinting off wet planks and the whites of her eyes. Expression: a squinting, impatient stare out to sea with a set jaw and a tight, eager mouth.

people.imagined: The weather-reader, an earlobe pierced twice for luck, wets a finger and holds it up to the wind.
people.subject: The moment: on a ship's deck he holds up a wet finger to the wind, eyes narrowed, calm, reading the weather. Face: most important, one earlobe pierced twice with two small gold rings, glinting, and a raised wet finger. It is a tanned, calm, honest face of twenty-six, smooth and brown, with dark eyes and fine lines at the corners from squinting, thin brows, a straight nose and a closed steady mouth. Hair: black, cropped, stiff with salt. Body: lean and balanced, riding the deck.
