Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with short sleeves exposing forearms tattooed with a small blue wave, a blue sailor's sash tied in a sheet-bend, and a small brass spyglass, dented at the end, at the belt. Hands and objects: one finger raised to the wind; a faint pale blue wind-line in the air beside it. The finger is wet and glistening and he holds it very still. Background: ship's rigging criss-crossing a pale sky, a flag streaming out flat in the wind, the deck planks wet and bright. Light: bright sea light from the upper left, glinting on the gold rings. The sun glitters on the sea behind him. Expression: calm and honest, brave, a steady, unhurried look of someone who trusts the wind to tell him the truth.

people.imagined: The slow oiler, blinking slowly as if the answer were far off, tung oil on the rag in his hands.
people.subject: The moment: oiling a pillar with a rag, he turns and blinks very slowly at the viewer as if the answer were far away. Face: most important, a slow, long blink, eyes half-closed, and a rag glistening amber with tung oil in his hand. It is a broad, placid, round face of twenty-nine, brown, with heavy-lidded eyes, thick brows, a snub nose, a mild mouth with the lips slightly parted, and a drop of oil shining on one cheek. Hair: black and short, bound with a rag-band. Body: big, slow and heavy. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with the cuffs darkened and stiff with amber oil, a grey sash smudged with it, and a pot of tung oil with a brush at his feet. Hands and objects: the shiny oil rag in his hands; a faint brown-green tint in the air. Background: a tall wooden hall pillar gleaming amber with fresh oil, a line of similar pillars receding into a soft haze, a warm glow lying on the floor. Light: soft amber light from the upper left, bright on the wet wood. Expression: patient and content, humble, a slow, mild, unhurried look as if the question had not quite reached him yet.

people.imagined: She waters old life trees with the steward, moss under her nails, carrying the news of a dead tree with him.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at the root of an ancient pine, she presses a mossy hand to the bark, carrying the news of a dead tree with the steward. Face: most important, moss and dark soil under every nail, and an old tree trunk beside her face. It is a calm, pale, quiet face of about forty, with steady grey eyes, thin brows, lines of worry between them, a small nose and a closed gentle mouth with pale lips. Hair: black with a streak of grey, in a bun with a pine twig. Body: slender and still. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, clean, with the sleeves rolled and the knees damp from kneeling, a green apron with a pocket of moss, and a small copper watering ladle at her belt. Hands and objects: moss-stained hands pressed to the bark; a faint green mist rises from the roots. Her nails are black with soil and a green smear of moss runs to the wrist. Background: an ancient pine with a twisted trunk rising into mist, small saplings with tiny tags dotting the slope, the air cold and white. Light: soft mist light from the upper left. The mist gives the bark a silver edge. Expression: a still, inward, quiet face with lowered eyes and a tight, held-back grief at the lips.

people.imagined: The Cliff Hall fighter with a bent nose from a fall on the cliff path, sworn brother of another, grinning cruelly.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a cliff path, he grins with sharp eyes, hands loose at his sides, weight on the back foot as though ready to shove; he is sworn brother of another Cliff Hall fighter. Face: most important, a nose bent hard to the left from an old break, plainly crooked, purple at the bridge, and a mocking grin. It is a hard, wind-burnt face of thirty-six, brown, with narrow glinting dark eyes, thick brows, a lopsided smile and a thin scar crossing the lip. Hair: black, tied back and tousled. Body: lean, strong and loose-limbed, shoulders loose, one knee slightly bent. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, clean, short-sleeved to show scarred forearms, a heavy leather belt with a plain iron buckle, and leather bracers laced tight. Hands and objects: the hands loose, one fist half clenched, the knuckles split; a faint grey-green sheen along the bracers. Background: a narrow cliff path dropping away to cloud, a rope handrail sagging between stakes, wet rock. Light: hard flat grey light from the upper left, leaving the broken bridge of his nose in shadow and a cold gleam along the bracers. Expression: cruel and brave, loyal, a sharp, lopsided grin with no warmth in the eyes.

people.imagined: Forest-born, she chose the ridge over the slope; her wild fringe, trimmed with a kitchen knife, falls over her stubborn eyes.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a grave on the ridge, she looks up stubbornly through an uneven fringe she trimmed herself with a kitchen knife; forest-born, she chose the ridge over the slope. Face: most important, a wild uneven fringe, cut with a kitchen knife, jagged across her forehead, and a stubborn gaze under it. It is a strong, plain, freckled face of thirty-two, olive, with dark, steady, defiant eyes, heavy brows, a straight nose and a firm mouth with the lip bitten. Hair: black, thick and long, with the jagged fringe. Body: sturdy and upright. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, clean, with the sleeves rolled and a green apron stained with sap, and a kitchen knife in a leather sheath at her belt. Hands and objects: earthy hands holding a small bunch of wild herbs; a faint green mist rising from them. The herbs are small white flowers and soft grey leaves, picked this morning. Background: an old stone grave with a leaning pine, a grey blanket of mist, a few wild herbs growing in the cracks of the stone. Light: pale light from the upper left. The mist-light makes her freckles stand out. Expression: stubborn and devout, honest, a plain, unflinching look that does not ask to be liked.

people.imagined: The gatekeeper of eighty years walks without a sound on loud gravel, propping a sideways pine with a cedar brace.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a gate beside a leaning pine propped by cedar braces, looking calmly aside; the gatekeeper of eighty years walks without a sound on loud gravel. Face: most important, a sideways-leaning old pine propped with pale cedar braces beside him, and a calm, silent face. It is a lean, long, still face of about fifty-five, dark, silent as stone, with deep-set dark steady eyes, thick grey brows hanging low, a long nose and a closed mouth. Hair: grey, tied in a plain topknot. Body: tall, spare and quiet. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, clean and neatly kept, a rope belt tied with a sailor's knot, felt-soled sandals so that he makes no sound, and a bundle of cedar wedges hanging at his hip. Hands and objects: one hand resting on a cedar brace; a faint green-grey haze in the air. Background: a stone gate with a worn threshold, the sideways pine propped by pale cedar braces, low mist among the roots. Light: pale light from the upper left. Expression: reclusive and patient, loyal, a silent, unmoving composure, the face of a man who has watched the gate for eighty years and has never needed to speak.

people.imagined: Oldest of the Cliff Hall inner disciples, squinting at the sky for rain before every sentence.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the open, he squints up at the sky for rain before answering, as he does before every sentence. Face: most important, eyes narrowed in a deep squint at the sky, and a lined brow. He appears about sixty-five, with a brown, deeply weathered face whose lines run like cracks, small pale eyes narrowed to slits, thick white brows bristling, a big nose and a tight mouth. Hair: white, tied in a hard knot. Body: tall, spare and bent. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, clean and faded soft by washing, mended neatly at the elbows, a rope belt knotted at the front, and a woven straw rain cape over one shoulder; a bony wrist shows from the sleeve. Hands and objects: one hand raised palm up to feel for rain; a faint grey-green haze in the air. Background: a pale heavy sky pressing on a bare ridge, a few dark pines standing against it, a cold wind lifting the cape. Light: pale cloud light from the upper left. Expression: stubborn and just, callous, the set, weathered look of the oldest of the Cliff Hall inner disciples, who judges every sky and every person with the same long squint.

people.imagined: A brewer, a burn ring round his wrist from a cauldron handle, eager to learn the best brew and testing on servants.
people.subject: The moment: at a cauldron, he stirs with intense concentration and glances up with ambition. Face, most important: a raised pink burn-ring scar all the way round his left wrist, plainly visible, and a long iron ladle. A sharp, ruddy, lean face of thirty-eight; dark eyes; thick brows; a hooked nose; a thin tight smile. His cheeks are ruddy from heat, his dark eyes burn with ambition, and sweat shines on his brow. Hair: black, cropped short. Body: wiry, tense. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe, leather apron, sleeves rolled. The leather apron is scorched, the sleeves rolled to show the pink burn-ring on his wrist, the robe's cuffs blackened, and a ladle of green liquid steams. Hands: stirring a green-glowing cauldron. Background: a furnace hall, green glow. Behind him a hall of green fire where rows of cauldrons bubble, shadows play on the brick wall, and smoke curls up to the rafters. Light: green glow from the lower left. Qi: a faint green-orange heat. He leans over the cauldron with his weight forward, shoulders hunched, so the green steam curls round his jaw; the glow lights the underside of his chin and brow and leaves his eye sockets dark, giving him an eager, hungry look. Expression: an intent, narrowed concentration with a sharp, ambitious glance and a tight mouth.

people.imagined: The tally-keeper laughs a round generous laugh she cannot keep down, a tally rod in her hand.
people.subject: The moment: laughing out loud with her head thrown back, a notched tally rod in hand, a round generous laugh she cannot keep down. Face: most important, a wide-open round laugh, head tipped back, cheeks full. It is a round, glowing, kind face of about forty, rosy, with bright eyes squeezed into crescents, soft brows, a short nose, a huge smile, shiny cheeks and a chin that doubles as the head tilts back. Hair: dark brown, in a loose bun with a straw pin. Body: plump and warm, the whole body shaking with the laugh, shoulders rounded and the round belly pushing against the apron, one hand pressed to the chest. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with the inner-gate collar loosened, the sleeves rolled above plump forearms, and a brown apron dusted with grain. Hands and objects: a tally stick notched with rows of cuts; a faint brown-gold tint in the air. Background: a granary door standing open on piled sacks of grain, golden dust hanging in a sunbeam, a cat sitting on a sack. Light: warm light from the upper left, from the doorway, turning the grain dust into floating gold and glowing on her cheeks. Expression: generous, honest and delighted, a whole-body laugh that comes before any attempt to stop it.

people.imagined: He walks the array's stones each dawn, his walking stick worn smooth by his grip, calm and faithless in loyalty.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn among array stones he leans on a smooth stick, looking at the viewer calmly, loyal in a way he does not mention. Face: most important, a long walking stick, polished smooth and dark at the top by a daily grip and pale with sweat, held in both hands. It is a lean, composed face of thirty-eight, light brown, with calm but guarded dark eyes, thin straight brows, a straight nose and a closed mouth as if sealing a secret. Hair: black, tied in a topknot with a grey cord worn tight. Body: slim and upright. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with the hem damp from dew, a neatly tied green array-runner's sash, and a small bag of chalk at the belt. Hands and objects: both hands on the polished stick; a faint green haze in the air. The cord at his waist is knotted with a count of every stone he has walked. Background: small standing stones in a row in pearly dawn mist, dew on the grass, a faint path trodden between them. Light: pale dawn light from the upper left. The dew on the stones catches the first light. Expression: cautious and calm, guarded, a still, closed face that has learned never to be the first to speak.

people.imagined: The investigator in a dry-hem robe, her hair in a knot so neat it looks painted, burning petitions unread.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk she regards the viewer coldly with a stack of papers at her elbow, an investigator burning petitions unread. Face: most important, a hair knot so perfectly neat and glossy it looks painted on, with not a single loose hair. It is a smooth, pale, impassive face of thirty-eight, with cool smooth skin, dark level eyes whose gaze never wavers, two exactly drawn straight brows, a straight nose and a thin firm mouth. Hair: black, in a smooth tight knot with a plain pin. Body: slim and rigid, the small hands lying still. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Hall of Rules, immaculate and without a single wrinkle, the narrow sleeves buttoned at the wrist and a plain sash tied flat. Hands and objects: one hand resting on bundled papers tied with a cord; a faint grey-green tint in the air. Background: a bare hall wall with one plain scroll rod hanging empty, a pale floor, and no ornament at all. Light: flat, even light from the upper left, with no shadow to soften her. Expression: just and callous, diligent, an unmoved, exact stare that has already decided what she will do with the page.

people.imagined: She weeds the osmanthus terraces humming half a tune that never finishes.
people.subject: The moment: weeding among osmanthus, she hums half a tune and looks up smiling. Face, most important: mouth shaped around a hum, head tilted, and a basket of weeds at her hip. A warm, plain, rosy face of about fifty; brown skin; kind dark eyes; thick brows; a rounded nose; a content smile. Her cheeks are rosy and weathered, her kind dark eyes crinkle, and her mouth shapes a half-tune. Hair: black with grey, in a straw-hatted bun. Body: sturdy, bent a little. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe, a straw hat, sleeves rolled, apron. The robe's sleeves are rolled, the apron is grass-stained, the straw hat has a green ribbon, and her hands are soil-brown; a small basket sits at her hip. Hands: a handful of weeds. Background: osmanthus terraces. Behind her terraces of osmanthus trees climb in rows with tiny golden flowers, bees hum, and a gentle breeze carries petals. Light: warm light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-gold. She works bent at the waist with one knee in the earth, then straightens halfway as she sings, a hand resting on the small of her back; dappled light slides over her hat brim and speckles her shoulders with gold petals. Expression: a soft, content smile with warm eyes lifted from her work, mid-hum.

people.imagined: He sits beside a spirit tree overnight asking leave to fell it, eyes dropping when an axe is mentioned.
people.subject: The moment: sitting against an old tree trunk at night, he drops his eyes as someone mentions an axe. Face, most important: lowered eyes, long lashes down, and a hand pressed to the bark. A gentle, long, pale face of about forty-five; soft dark eyes; thin brows; a long nose; a soft mouth. His lashes are long and lowered, his skin pale, and his mouth soft and sorrowful. Hair: black, in a plain knot. Body: lean, still. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe, damp hem, a temple-style cord at the waist. The robe's damp hem trails on leaf-mould, the cord at his waist is temple-style with two tassels, and a small oil lamp is shuttered beside him; his hand on the bark is gentle. Hands: a palm on bark. Background: a dark forest, a lantern. Behind him a black forest at night with huge trunks, a single lantern glows on a root, and moonlight silvers a few leaves. Light: soft lantern light from the lower left. Qi: a faint green mist. He sits with his back against the trunk, knees drawn up and one hand resting flat on the bark as if on a sleeper's chest; the lantern leaves half his face in black shadow and picks out the wet gleam of his lowered lashes. Expression: lowered eyes and a sorrowful, gentle mouth, the head bowed a little as the axe is named.

people.imagined: A boatman's rope scar across both palms, a Cold Ford fighter spitting at the mention of letters.
people.subject: The moment: on a river quay he turns his head and spits to the side at the mention of a name, angry and loyal. Face: most important, a thick white rope scar across both palms, both hands held open and showing it. It is a hard, square, weathered face of thirty-eight, dark, with narrow bloodshot hostile eyes, a vein showing at the temple, thick brows, a flat nose, and a deep scowling mouth. Hair: black, cropped. Body: solid and thick-necked, legs wide and shoulders forward, chin thrust out, one hand clenched at his thigh. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with short sleeves on thick forearms, a cracked leather vest, and a tight blue Cold Ford sash. Hands and objects: open palms scarred with thick white old rope marks; a faint blue frost in the air. Background: a foggy river quay with a dark boat at the pier, coils of rope, a grey sky pressed low, mist drifting across his boots. Light: cold light from the upper left, showing the stubble and the vein in his neck. Expression: warlike and angry, loyal, a heavy scowl with the lip lifted slightly, the look of a boatman who has just heard a name he hates.

people.imagined: She lights the lamp on a Cold Ford boat at dusk with a pleasant blank face that gives nothing away, while she thinks of her monthly letter.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a boat she lights a small lantern with a taper and looks up with a pleasantly blank, smooth face, thinking of her monthly letter. Face: most important, a perfectly smooth, blank, pleasant expression, eyes friendly but empty, with a lit taper held up beside it, the flame on her cheek. It is a plain, round, comfortable face of thirty-six, light brown, smooth as a cushion, with calm grey-brown eyes, soft level brows, a small nose and a mild small smile. Hair: black, in a neat low bun with a blue cord. Body: soft and sturdy. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with sleeves rolled neatly, a pale blue Cold Ford sash tied in a plain knot, a small brown lamp-keeper's apron with spare wicks in its pocket, and a tiny bell at her belt. Hands and objects: a taper lighting a paper boat lamp; a faint blue water hint in the air. Background: the dark river carrying a drifting line of small paper-lit lamps on boats, a dim far bank, a deep blue sky with the first star. Light: warm taper glow from the lower left, blue dusk behind. Expression: peaceable and pleasant, an impenetrable, mild smile that gives nothing away and has never been asked to.

people.imagined: A pill-ship captain on deck, a bowl of herb broth in one hand and a strip of dried fish in the other, grinning and never saying which he prefers.
people.subject: The moment: at the ship's rail he raises a bowl of herb broth in one hand and a strip of salted fish in the other, grinning and refusing to say which he prefers. Face: most important, a bowl of steaming dark broth in one hand and a long strip of dried fish in the other, both held up level. It is a ruddy, laughing, weathered face of thirty-eight with bright blue eyes, thick sun-bleached brows dusted with small salt crystals, a broad red peeling nose, deep laugh-lines beside the mouth and a big grin. Hair: dark brown, salt-stiff, tied with a rope cord. Body: stocky and barrel-chested. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with the sleeves rolled over scarred forearms, a blue captain's sash stained with fish oil, an oiled leather vest, and a brass whistle on a cord at the neck. Hands and objects: the broth and the fish held level; a faint blue-green water haze. Background: the ship's rail, coiled ropes and a mast, a pale sea with white-caps and a gull hanging in the wind. Light: bright sea light from the upper left. Expression: gregarious and brave, greedy, a wide, laughing look of a pill-ship captain who wants both and will not choose.

people.imagined: A midwife's daughter on the Green Door Day, sleeves rolled, strong forearms setting a child's bone with a calm word.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a small patient, she sets a bone with strong steady hands and murmurs a calm word, sleeves rolled high. Face: most important, bare muscular forearms, thick as a smith's, with the sleeves tied high, and steady hands on a small arm. It is a broad, warm, calm face of about forty, brown, with patient dark eyes lined with fatigue, thick soft brows, a broad nose and a gentle mouth. Hair: black, in a low braid wrapped with a green cloth. Body: broad and sturdy. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with the sleeves tied above the elbow with green cord, a spotless white healer's apron, and a small satchel of splints at her side. Hands and objects: scrubbed pink hands setting a small arm in splints; a faint warm green glow at the fingers. The splints are of pale bamboo tied with green cord, laid ready on a cloth beside her. Background: a bright healing room with pallets in rows, bundles of herbs hanging, the green-painted door open to daylight. Light: soft light from the upper left. A little warm light falls across the child's small arm. Expression: compassionate and patient, calm, the steady, unhurried gentleness of a midwife's daughter on the Green Door Day.

people.imagined: Six years of a leafless life tree; a dried mugwort sprig behind her ear, steady smile through the worry.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a bare sapling she smiles a little tightly, brave about her slow tree, six years without a leaf. Face: most important, a dried grey-green mugwort sprig tucked behind her right ear, and a leafless small tree beside her. It is a thin, freckled, earnest face of twenty, fair, with dense freckles across the nose, pale lashes, quietly stubborn hazel eyes, thin brows, a small nose and a brave small smile. Hair: light brown, in a plain braid. Body: thin and narrow-shouldered, slightly pigeon-toed, hands clasped in front and chin tilted up to seem brave. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe a little too big, the sleeves cuffed twice, a grey sash tied in a bow, and a small watering gourd at the belt; the dried mugwort behind her ear gives off a faint grey-green dust. Hands and objects: one hand on the sapling's bare twig; a faint pale green tint beside it. Background: a hillside of young saplings with coloured cords, one tree among them bare, dim morning mist. Light: pale light from the upper left, falling evenly on her freckled face and the thin grey twig. Expression: a small steady smile worn a little tightly over worried eyes, a brave, hopeful face.

people.imagined: A carter's son carrying soil in the evening for a friend's plot, red soil dried on his shins.
people.subject: The moment: carrying a heavy basket of earth in the evening, he pauses and wipes his brow. Face, most important: dried red soil caked on both shins and the hem of his robe, and a basket of dark earth on his back. A broad, open, sunburnt face of nineteen; brown skin; steady dark eyes; thick brows; a blunt nose; a friendly mouth. His cheeks are sunburnt, his eyes steady, and a smear of red earth marks his jaw. Hair: black, short. Body: big, strong. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe, grey sash, sleeves rolled. The robe's hem is stiff with red clay, the sleeves rolled, the grey sash dusty, and the basket straps have worn pale grooves in his shoulders. Hands: a strap of the basket. Background: a hillside plot, dusk. Behind him a hillside plot being dug in the last of the light, a spade stuck in the earth, and a rosy sky. Light: low warm light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown earth haze. His body leans slightly forward under the weight, thumbs hooked in the straps, the muscles of his neck standing out; the low sun lights the red clay on his legs to a rust glow and throws a long shadow across the plot. Expression: a tired, gentle face with a damp brow and a mild, faithful smile.

people.imagined: Dark rings under his eyes from watering his silent tree three times a day, envious and tired.
people.subject: The moment: carrying a watering can before dawn, he looks at the viewer with exhausted, envious eyes. Face, most important: very dark rings under both eyes, deep and plain, and a watering can in his hand. A thin, pale, tired face of twenty-three; dark restless eyes; thin brows; a sharp nose; a tight mouth. His eyes are sunken and red-rimmed, his lips dry, and a day's stubble shadows his chin. Hair: black, untidy. Body: thin, stooped. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe, damp at the hem, grey sash. The robe's hem is soaked, the grey sash is crooked, the sleeves are wet to the elbow, and he holds the watering can's handle with both hands like a lifeline. Hands: a wooden watering can. Background: a dim dawn with a sapling. Behind him the first grey light touches rows of tagged saplings, mist coils in the hollows, and a single bird calls. Light: grey pre-dawn light from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale green. He holds himself like a tightly wound spring, shoulders high, knuckles whitening on the handle, and drips of water run off the spout onto his sandals; the grey light shows every shadow of his sleepless face. Expression: anxious, determined, envious.

people.imagined: The younger sister oils the halls and keeps retying her oil-stained apron strings, bet she'll reach the First Leaf first.
people.subject: The moment: retying the strings of her apron behind her back, she twists at the waist and looks over her shoulder with a competitive grin; she has bet she will reach the First Leaf first. Face: most important, oil-darkened apron strings tied in a quick bow at her waist, shiny and stained amber. It is a round, bright, freckled face of twenty-one, brown, with round amber-smudged cheeks, sparkling dark eyes, thick brows lifted in challenge, a snub nose and a cheeky grin. Hair: black, in two high buns, a wisp stuck to her cheek. Body: small and quick, one shoulder dropped and chin over it as she reaches behind. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with the sleeves rolled, an apron stiff with amber oil, its strings twice retied, a grey sash darkened by oil, and a small rag tucked in the belt. Hands and objects: both hands behind her tying the apron; a faint pale green tint on the oiled strings. Background: a wooden hall pillar shining amber with fresh oil, a pot and brush standing on the floor, warm light filling the hall. Light: warm amber light from the upper left, bouncing off the freshly oiled wood and lending her skin a glow. Expression: ambitious and cheeky, cheerful, a quick, competitive grin thrown over the shoulder.

people.imagined: A warden's niece with her uncle's long jaw, asking bright questions about furnaces.
people.subject: The moment: leaning in curiously with an eager question, her hand raised, asking bright questions about furnaces. Face: most important, a long angular jaw, her uncle the warden's, strong and prominent in a young face. It is a long, lively, fair face of twenty-four with a flush on the cheeks, keen alert green-brown eyes, arched brows, a straight nose and an eager open mouth. Hair: chestnut, in a high braid with a wooden pin. Body: tall and slim, leaning in with chin tilted up, one foot half a step forward and hands moving as she talks. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe, the cuff showing a flash of pine-green lining, a grey sash tied neatly, a small notebook of folded paper hanging from the belt, and one sleeve smudged with charcoal. Hands and objects: one hand raised in question; a faint green-gold tint at the fingers. Background: the furnace hall door glowing green behind her, the shadows of cauldrons looming, warm air shimmering. Light: a green glow from the lower left, tinting one side of her face and caught in her bright eyes. Expression: curious and gregarious, trusting, the open, hungry look of a girl who expects every question to have a good answer.

people.imagined: A cousin from the poria village, dimples she is annoyed at, reminding her rival she joined first.
people.subject: The moment: arms folded, she smirks with a toss of the head, dimples showing and annoyed by them, reminding her rival that she joined first. Face: most important, deep dimples in both cheeks, clearly marked even as she tries to frown. It is a round, rosy, bright face of seventeen, brown, with sparkling mock-fierce dark eyes, thin brows, a small nose and a smirk. Hair: black, in two braids tied with green ribbons that glow in the morning light. Body: small and brisk, weight on one hip, chin lifted, a foot tapping the flagstones in time with her smirk. Clothing: a crisp, clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with the sleeves rolled up for a quarrel, and a grey sash tied in a bow. Hands and objects: arms crossed over her chest, fingers drumming on the sleeve; a faint pale green tint in the ribbons. Background: a courtyard of pale stone with a small fountain and a few students looking on in bright morning. Light: bright light from the upper left, deepening the shadows in her cheek dimples. Expression: smug and stubborn, cheerful, the satisfied, challenging look of a cousin from the poria village who has been first all her life.

people.imagined: A stonecutter's sister sent north, walking with a stiff, unbowed back among the terrace stones; she has not accepted this life.
people.subject: The moment: standing very straight among stacked terrace stones, chin high, refusing to bend; a stonecutter's sister sent north who has not accepted this life. Face: most important, a strikingly rigid upright spine and carriage, chin up, shoulders back, the whole small frame drawn up to its full height. It is a proud, square, tanned face of seventeen with a set square jaw, dark defiant eyes burning under thick straight brows, a short nose and a tight mouth. Hair: black, in a tight single braid. Body: sturdy and very upright, heels together, fists clenched at her sides. Clothing: a clean, neat, slightly stiff green-grey hemp outer-gate robe, a grey sash tied tight, cuffs dusty with stone, and sturdy shoes. Hands and objects: one hand resting on a stone, the other fist tight at her side; a faint brown earth haze at her boots. Background: stacked terrace stones in neat piles, a half-built wall, a pale sky, the shadow of the stone pile falling across her boots. Light: bright light from the upper left, flattening her proud face into clean planes. Expression: proud and resentful, stubborn, the clenched, unyielding look of a girl who is holding herself together by standing straight.

people.imagined: A raftsman who has fallen in the river more than any disciple, fresh bruise on the cheek, dripping and laughing.
people.subject: The moment: dripping wet, hauling himself out of a river onto a log with a rueful laugh, having fallen in more often than any disciple. Face: most important, a fresh dark purple-yellow bruise swelling on his cheekbone and wet hair plastered to his brow. It is a boyish, cheerful, battered face of twenty-five, brown, with bright dark eyes shut in laughter, thick brows, a crooked nose and a wide laugh. Hair: black, soaked and plastered. Body: lean and strong, sprawled half across the log with one knee up and the other leg trailing in the water, shoulders heaving. Clothing: a wet green-grey hemp robe clinging to him, a dripping blue river sash, sleeves rolled, a long scrape down one forearm, and sandals that squelch. Hands and objects: both hands gripping the log; a faint blue water spray in the air. The bark of the log is wet and black, and he has a cut across one knuckle. Background: a brown river running fast with floating logs, a muddy bank, spray catching the sun in small rainbows. Light: bright light from the upper left, blazing off the wet skin of his neck. The river throws wet light up under his chin. Expression: cheerful and rueful, brave, a laugh with the eyes shut and nothing in it of embarrassment.

people.imagined: The only disciple the spirit bees have never stung, bees circling her hair, sweet scent.
people.subject: The moment: standing calm while several golden bees circle her head and rest in her hair. Face, most important: golden bees crawling in her hair and on her shoulders, undisturbed, and a serene smile. A soft, round, sweet face of twenty; golden-brown skin; warm amber eyes; thin brows; a small nose; a gentle smile. Her cheeks are round and golden, her eyes amber and serene, and a bee rests on her eyebrow. Hair: honey-brown, in a loose braid with bees. Body: slim, relaxed. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with a pale yellow cord, grey sash. The robe is clean with a pale yellow cord sash, the sleeves loose, and a few bees crawl on her collar; her hands are open and relaxed. Hands: open palms with a bee on one. Background: blurred hives, sun. Behind her white wooden hives in a meadow of clover, a haze of bees in sun, and a warm blue sky. Light: warm gold light from the upper left. Qi: a faint golden shimmer. She stands very still with arms slightly out from her sides, palms up, shoulders soft, while the bees move over her in slow golden threads; warm sunlight turns her hair to honey and makes her eyes glow amber. Expression: a serene, calm face with half-lidded eyes and a soft, quiet smile as the bees settle.

people.imagined: A letter-runner who glances over his shoulder so the Cold Ford watch does not see him come.
people.subject: The moment: on a path, he glances nervously over his shoulder, letter satchel clutched against him. Face, most important: a quick nervous glance over the shoulder, head half turned, eyes wide, and a satchel clutched to the chest. A narrow, pale, anxious face of twenty-six; wide brown eyes; thin brows; a long nose; a tight worried mouth. His eyes are wide and shifting, his lips thin, and sweat beads at his hairline. Hair: black, short. Body: thin, tense. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp inner-gate robe, narrow sleeves, a messenger's cord belt. The robe's narrow sleeves are tied, the messenger's cord belt is tight, the leather satchel is cracked, and his sandals are muddy; a letter-tube is strapped to his back. Hands: gripping a leather satchel. Background: a misty path. Behind him a misty path winds between dark pines, a signpost leans, and cool grey light filters through. Light: cool light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green haze. His body is half turned away, one shoulder high and the satchel clasped under his arm, the free hand gripping his sleeve; the dim light under the pines leaves his face grey and his wide eyes shining. Expression: nervous, evasive, alert.

people.imagined: Dozing beside a spirit tree at night, head nodding at the quietest moments.
people.subject: The moment: sitting under a tree at night, his head nods down toward his chest in sleep. Face, most important: a head drooping forward with closed eyes, mid-nod, mouth a little open. A round, soft, boyish face of twenty-four; fair skin; closed eyes; thick brows; a snub nose; a slack mouth. His cheeks are soft and flushed with sleep, his lashes dark on his cheek, and a thread of drool glints at his lip. Hair: brown, tousled. Body: slouched, heavy. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe, damp hem, a temple-style cord. The robe's damp hem trails on moss, the temple-style cord is loosened, a wool blanket is half over his knees, and his hands lie slack. Hands: a cloth blanket in his lap. Background: a dark forest, one lantern. Behind him a black forest with a huge spirit tree, a single lantern burning low, and a few fireflies. Light: soft lantern light from the lower left. Qi: a faint pale green. His whole torso slumps forward with the weight of the head, arms loose and the blanket sliding off one knee; the lantern's low glow makes a small warm island on his cheek and the roots about him. Expression: sleepy, peaceful, guilty.

people.imagined: The fire-tender whose nose twitches at every smell, sniffing a log to tell spirit wood from dead.
people.subject: The moment: sniffing a split log with a twitching nose, eyes closed, sure of himself, telling spirit wood from dead. Face: most important, a long nose twitching and wrinkled mid-sniff, held close to a split log. It is a thin, eager, soot-smudged face of twenty-two, dark-skinned, with closed creased eyes, thick brows, a long nose and a pleased mouth. Hair: black and short. Body: lean and wiry, bending forward with the log held to his face and the shoulders raised, the whole body concentrating through the nose. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp inner-gate robe with the sleeves tied, a soot-black leather apron, and a green sash greasy from work. Hands and objects: a split log held in both hands to the nose, the hands streaked with ash; a faint green fire hint at the cut face. The log is pale inside and shows rings of fine grain, still damp with resin. Background: a furnace with green flames, a stack of logs, a hot orange-green glow on the brick. Light: green glow from the lower left, washing his sooty cheeks and highlighting the sweat above his lip. Sweat gleams on his forehead. Expression: diligent and pleased, focused, a rapt, eyes-shut concentration like a man tasting wine.

people.imagined: A coil of measuring cord always on her wrist, a junior mapping where the stones would be.
people.subject: The moment: measuring between two array stones with a cord stretched taut, her head turned to sight along it. Face: most important, a neat coil of measuring cord worn round her wrist like a bracelet, and another cord pulled tight in both hands. It is a sharp, neat, serious face of twenty-one, pale, with bright quick dark eyes, straight brows, a small nose and a tight focused mouth. Hair: black, in a tight bun. Body: slim and upright, braced with feet apart and arms outstretched. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp inner-gate robe with chalk-white cuffs, a tidy green sash, and a small plumb bob at the belt. Hands and objects: stretching the cord between her hands, the coil on her wrist; a faint green line follows it. The cord is waxed red and knotted at one-hand intervals, and it does not sag. Background: array stones standing in a precise line in dawn mist, a cord stretched between two of them, dew on the grass gleaming on her sandals. Light: pale dawn light from the upper left, giving her face a clear precise outline. The dew on the grass shines silver. Expression: focused and ambitious, careful, the narrowed, exact attention of a junior who is mapping where the stones will be.

people.imagined: A junior clerk with spotless hem edges even on the slope, quietly correcting a verdict he dislikes.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk, he corrects a page with a small neat stroke and glances up unrepentant. Face, most important: a pure dry spotless hem edge on his robe visible at the lower frame, immaculately clean, and a calm self-righteous face. A neat, narrow, pale face of twenty-seven; cold dark eyes; thin brows; a sharp nose; a prim mouth. His eyes are cold and dark, his lips pressed prim, and his skin pale and smooth. Hair: black, tightly tied. Body: slim, straight. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Hall of Rules, immaculate. The robe is spotless and dry, the hem edge perfect, the sleeves buttoned at the wrist, and the dark sash tied flat; a brush rests in a neat holder. Hands: a brush correcting a page. Background: a blank hall wall. Behind him a bare wall and a clean desk with a single closed book, and cool white light. Light: flat light from the upper left. Qi: a faint grey-green. He sits with the spine perfectly straight, elbow squared on the desk, the brush held like a scalpel; the flat light leaves no shadow on his smooth pale face and makes the page glow white. Expression: just, self-righteous, cold.

people.imagined: Watering a friend's unsown plot when nobody is looking, a wheat-gold plait to her waist.
people.subject: The moment: tiptoeing with a watering gourd cradled to her chest, glancing round, about to water a friend's bare plot when nobody is looking. Face: most important, a thick wheat-gold plait to her waist, shining pale yellow over her shoulder. It is a warm, round, open face of twenty-four, fair, with soft light brown eyes, soft brows, a short nose, a few freckles and a shy smile. Hair: wheat-gold, in a long braid that swings as she moves. Body: tall and soft, shoulders hunched as she tiptoes forward. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp inner-gate robe with the green collar loosened and the sleeves rolled, a bit of straw clinging to the hem. Hands and objects: a wet, dripping gourd of water held to her chest; a faint brown-gold tint around it. The gourd is a small brown calabash wrapped in a net of cord, dripping on her toes. Background: an unsown plot of bare earth, a low fence, a golden evening sky. Light: golden evening light from the upper left, lighting the wheat-gold hair and turning the bare earth rosy. Long gold shadows stretch behind her. Expression: kind and gentle, furtive, the guilty, tender look of someone doing a good deed in secret and fearful of being thanked.

people.imagined: Pale as a cold jar, born at the new seat, wondering why anyone would go back up the mountain.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the seed vault, she holds a cold clay jar and looks puzzled. Face, most important: extremely pale skin, bluish white like a cold jar, and a frosty clay seed jar held to her chest. A thin, delicate face of twenty; milk-pale skin; light grey eyes; pale brows; a small nose; a closed small mouth. Her cheeks are blue-white, her eyes light grey, and her lips pale as a petal. Hair: pale brown, in a low knot. Body: slim, still. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp inner-gate robe, grey apron, a cool-grey shawl. The robe is a pale grey-green, the cool-grey shawl pinned at the throat, the apron immaculate, and her hands are cold and still on the jar. Hands: a cold jar. Background: shelves of seed jars. Behind her shelves of frosted jars in rows, a thin mist from a cold vent, and blue light. Light: cool blue light from the upper left. Qi: a faint frost-green mist. She holds the jar against her breastbone with both hands and a slight lean back, her shoulders narrow and still; the blue light from the vent leaves her skin ghostly and frosts the glaze of the jar with highlights. Expression: puzzled, cool, young.

people.imagined: A climber's bow-legged stance on the cliff path, deciding sparring bouts by mood.
people.subject: The moment: on a cliff path he stands in a wide bow-legged stance with arms folded, judging, deciding a sparring bout by mood. Face: most important, a deliberate bowed-leg wide stance, knees out, and arms crossed. It is a hard, tanned, squared face of twenty-six, with sharp narrow dark eyes sliding sideways, thick brows, a flat nose, a mocking mouth and a line of sweat running down the jaw. Hair: black, cropped. Body: stocky, short and strong, thick arms folded, chin tucked, one shoulder dropped in contempt, feet planted on gravel. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, clean and short-sleeved, a heavy belt, and leather bracers. Hands and objects: arms folded, the bracers gleaming; a faint grey-green sheen on them. His knuckles are scarred and his thick fingers are tucked under his folded arms, the thumbs showing. Background: a cliff path winding into mist, a few pines clinging to the edge, a grey sky. Light: cold grey light from the upper left, leaving one side of his face in shadow. A little pale light shows the sweat at his hairline and the stubble on his chin. Mist drifts across the path behind him. Expression: tough and proud, arbitrary, the heavy-lidded sideways glance of a man who has already made up his mind.

people.imagined: A big gap-toothed grin on a plain round face, making the Cliff Hall laugh.
people.subject: The moment: laughing with a huge grin, she makes a joke in a grim place, making the Cliff Hall laugh. Face: most important, a big wide grin showing a gap between her front teeth. It is a plain, round, jolly face of twenty-three, brown, with shiny round cheeks, small bright eyes, thick brows, a flat nose and a gap-toothed grin. Hair: brown, in a thick short plait. Body: round and sturdy, rocking back with the laugh, shoulders shaking, arms flung wide and the sleeves slapping. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, clean, the sleeves rolled, a white wax-cloth sash tied in a bow, and a smudge of wax on one cuff. Hands and objects: arms spread wide in the telling of the joke; a faint pale green tint at the fingers. Her palms are broad and pink, the sleeves flapping wide as she flings them out. Background: a stone hall with a long table, a few other disciples laughing, a warm lamp, their shadows jiggling on the wall behind her. Light: grey daylight from the upper left, with warm lamplight in the hall warming her round cheeks. The lamplight picks out the shine on her round forehead. Expression: jolly and warm, brave, a huge, easy, gap-toothed laugh that lifts the room.

people.imagined: The cook's grandson peeling roots, knife scars up his left forearm, taking his grandfather's side on salt.
people.subject: The moment: peeling a root with a short knife, he looks up defiantly. Face, most important: a ladder of thin white knife scars up his left forearm, shown with the sleeve rolled, and a root and knife in his hands. A round, flushed, cheeky face of nineteen; brown skin; bright eyes; thick brows; a blunt nose; a stubborn grin. His cheeks are round and flushed, his brows thick, and a smear of flour marks his forehead. Hair: black, cropped. Body: stocky. Clothing: a clean plain brown hemp tunic, a white apron, a cloth sweat band. The white apron is stained, the brown tunic's left sleeve rolled to show the ladder of scars, a cloth band round his forehead soaks his sweat, and his hands are red from cold water. Hands: peeling a pale root. Background: a steamy kitchen. Behind him a steamy kitchen with a big iron pot, hanging ladles, and a basket of unpeeled roots. Light: warm light from the lower left. Qi: a faint grey hint. He hunches over the root with elbows out, knife moving, then lifts his head with a stubborn thrust of the chin; steam curls past his face and the firelight glints on the scarred forearm. Expression: a cheeky, defiant look with a raised chin, a crooked half-grin and bright, stubborn eyes.

people.imagined: The gatekeeper's daughter sweeping the founder's grave at dawn, pine needles pressed into her braid.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn she sweeps needles off the founder's grave, then looks up gently; she is the gatekeeper's daughter. Face: most important, dry pine needles pressed into her braid like pins, and a soft pine-twig broom held upright in her hand. It is a thin, quiet, pale face of twenty-four, with gentle grey eyes under long lashes, thin brows, a small nose and a gentle mouth. Hair: black, in a long braid stuck with pine needles. Body: slender, standing with the broom held upright like a staff and her weight on one foot, head slightly bowed. Clothing: a clean plain undyed hemp robe with the sleeves rolled and a brown apron smudged with pine resin. Hands and objects: both hands on the pine-twig broom; a faint green mist rises from the grave. The broom is made of a bundle of twigs bound with fresh bark. Background: an old stone grave under a spreading pine, fallen needles lying in drifts, a pale dawn sky. Light: pale dawn light from the upper left, soft on her face, a few fine pine needles drifting down through it. Single needles drift down, gold at the tips. Expression: gentle and quiet, devoted, the calm, lowered look of a girl who has swept this grave every morning for as long as she can remember.

people.imagined: The water-carrier, short of breath after every flight of steps, learning to breathe on the climb.
people.subject: The moment: halting on a cliff stair, chest heaving, with two buckets on a pole, learning to breathe on the climb. Face: most important, an open gasping mouth and a heaving chest, and a pole with two buckets across his shoulders. It is a thin, flushed, honest face of thirty, brown, with tired kind eyes, thick brows, a blunt nose, and a bead of sweat hanging from the chin. Hair: black, sweaty and tied back. Body: wiry and stooped, bent forward with his hands on the pole and knees slightly flexed. Clothing: a clean plain brown hemp tunic, dark with sweat, and a damp cloth pad on one shoulder that is thin with use. Hands and objects: both hands on the pole, polished smooth by his palms; the rope handles of both buckets are knotted at the ends and the water inside is clear, a green leaf floating in one. The pole bends under the buckets and a little water slops over the edge. Background: a steep cliff stair cut into rock, long shadows thrown across it. Light: bright light from the upper left, making the wet buckets flash. The shadow of the pole falls across the steps. Expression: tired and determined, a gasping, honest effort with no complaint, the look of a man who will make the next landing.

people.imagined: Dike mud to the knees all year, believing the spirit rice is bread.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a salt-marsh dike with a spade, mud to the knees, trusting and calm, believing the spirit rice is bread. Face: most important, thick grey mud caked to the knees and splashed up his robe, and a spade planted beside him. It is a weathered, plain, trusting face of twenty-three, dark-skinned and windburned, with round eyes, thick brows, a flat nose and a smear of grey mud across the cheek. Hair: black and short. Body: sturdy, standing calf-deep with both hands folded on top of the spade and his chin resting on them. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with the hem tucked up into a dull blue sash, mud caked to the knees and drying pale on the sleeve. Hands and objects: the spade, its blade bright from use; a faint blue water haze. The wooden handle of the spade is pale and smooth from use. Background: long dikes of earth holding back grey water, a patch of green rice shoots, gulls wheeling. Light: grey light from the upper left, even and soft on his round face. A thin line of pale sun glints on the wet mud. Expression: trusting and diligent, simple, a plain, open calm like a man who has never had cause to doubt the work.

people.imagined: A salt-fish seller's daughter wearing a fish-scale earring, following a boy everywhere.
people.subject: The moment: peeking round a corner, she glances at someone out of frame with a keen sly smile, following a boy everywhere. Face: most important, a silver fish-scale earring dangling from her ear and flashing in the sun, and a sideways peek. It is a round, pretty face of twenty-one, brown, with flushed cheeks, bright sly dark eyes under long lashes, arched brows, a small nose and a smile. Hair: black, in a high tail with a small bone comb. Body: slim, leaning out from the wall with one hand on the corner and the other cupped near her mouth, head tilted, toes lifted. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with narrow sleeves and a blue sash tied in a bow. Hands and objects: one hand on the wall; a faint blue shimmer around the earring. Her nails are pink and neat and her bracelet is a thin braided cord. Background: a narrow harbour alley with fish racks and a hanging net, her shadow thrown on the alley wall. Light: bright sun from the upper left, picking out the silver of the earring. A fish-scale glint flickers on her cheek. Expression: sly and curious, devoted, the bright, hungry look of a salt-fish seller's daughter who thinks no one has noticed her.

people.imagined: A fighter whose steady gaze skirts one stretch of the river, never asking why his teacher avoids it.
people.subject: The moment: standing on river ice, his gaze steady but carefully skirting one dark stretch of water at the edge of the frame, jaw tight, never asking why his teacher avoids it. Face: most important, his eyes deliberately fixed away from the dark stretch of river, and a muscle ticking in his jaw. It is a lean, sharp, calm face of twenty-five, pale, with steady grey eyes, thin brows, a straight nose and a firm thin-lipped mouth. Hair: black, tied back. Body: lean and strong, standing square on the ice with feet apart. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp inner-gate robe with a pale grey fur collar frosted with rime, a tight blue sash, sleeves bound at the wrists, and spiked boots for ice. Hands and objects: an iron ice-spike held point down; a faint blue frost in the air. His grip is sure and loose and the spike's iron shoe glints at the lower edge. Background: river ice stretching in white-blue sheets under mist, a dark stretch glinting at the edge of the frame, breath hanging in the cold. Light: cold light from the upper left, lying flat on his lean face. A white glare of ice lights his lower lip. Expression: calm and cautious, loyal, a held, level look that refuses to turn toward what it knows is there.

people.imagined: A deck hand proud of a tuft of beard, who promised eagle feathers and sold them.
people.subject: The moment: stroking a tuft of beard, he grins with a feather hidden behind his back; he promised eagle feathers and sold them. Face: most important, a small proud tuft of dark wispy beard on the chin, held between finger and thumb. It is a young, sly, tanned face of twenty-two, with sun-freckles on the nose, bright shifty dark eyes, thick brows, a snub nose and a wide grin. Hair: black, wind-tossed. Body: lean, leaning back against a barrel with one arm behind him, chest out and chin lifted, one foot crossed over the other. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with the sleeves rolled, an oiled sea vest stiff with salt, a blue sash knotted at the side, and a pocket that bulges with something feathery. Hands and objects: one hand at the beard, one hidden behind; a faint blue water haze. The hidden hand holds a long white feather that curls round his hip. Background: the pill ship's deck with coiled ropes, a barrel and a bright sea. Light: bright sea light from the upper left. Salt spray glints on his sleeve and in his hair, and a gull screams somewhere out of frame. Expression: cheeky and greedy, a guilty, delighted grin that is pleased with its own lie.

people.imagined: A herder girl with a long stride playing the flute softly to spirit cattle at dusk.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk she plays a bamboo flute very softly, eyes closed, to spirit cattle lying in the pasture beyond. Face: most important, a bamboo flute at her lips, played softly, and eyes closed. It is a long, tanned, calm face of twenty-three with thick brows, a straight nose and closed eyelids resting calm. Hair: black, in a long braid. Body: tall and long-limbed, standing with her weight on one long leg, elbows lifted as she holds the flute, head slightly tilted. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe cut short for a long stride, a herder's leather vest, a bamboo switch hanging at her belt, and good boots. Hands and objects: both hands on the flute; a faint green-gold tint in the air. The flute is a pale bamboo with five finger-holes, and her fingers are long. Background: a dusk pasture with the dark shapes of cattle lying down, a lilac sky and the first star, the cattle blurred behind her. Light: lilac dusk light from the upper left, giving her face a soft violet cast. Her braid shines with the last of the day. Expression: gentle and calm, focused, the unhurried stillness of a herder who has found the tune the cattle like.

people.imagined: A Marten Yard junior with sleepy silver marten kits peeking out of both cuffs.
people.subject: The moment: holding her arms up stiffly in front of her as two small silver marten kits peek from her cuffs, so as not to wake them. Face: most important, two silver marten kits' small heads poking out of both sleeve cuffs. It is a soft, round, rosy face of twenty, fair, with bright green-brown delighted eyes, thin brows, a button nose and a shy smile. Hair: light brown, in two buns. Body: small, with shoulders lifted and chin tucked. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp inner-gate robe with wide sleeves, the cuffs lined with silver-grey fur, and a small cloth bag of kit-food at her belt. Hands and objects: both arms raised, the kits' heads at the cuffs; a faint silver-green tint on the fur. The kits are the size of a thumb, their ears small and round, their eyes shut tight. Background: a yard of wooden hutches with straw, a few older martens perched on a post. Light: soft light from the upper left, lighting the silver fur at her cuffs and the pink of her cheeks. Tiny silver hairs shine in the light at her wrists. Expression: tender and delighted, a shy, held-breath smile of a Marten Yard junior who is afraid of ending the moment.

people.imagined: He came to the Green Door at twelve with a broken arm set slightly crooked, carrying water ever since.
people.subject: The moment: carrying a water pail, he holds one forearm out a little crooked; he came to the Green Door at twelve with a broken arm set slightly crooked, and has carried water ever since. Face: most important, his right forearm set slightly crooked, bowed in the middle, plain where the sleeve is rolled. It is a quiet, thin, plain face of twenty-one, brown, with sad kind eyes, thin brows, a long nose, thin lips and a faint line by the mouth. Hair: black and short. Body: lean and slightly hunched, shoulders drawn in as if used to being overlooked, the faint stoop of long carrying. Clothing: a clean, plain green-grey hemp outer-gate robe with the right sleeve rolled to show the arm, and a pale blue Healing House sash tied loosely. Hands and objects: a water pail hanging from the crooked arm, its rope having rubbed the palm. His fingers are thin and a little blue with cold round the rope. Background: a healing house door painted green, a stone threshold, a quiet courtyard. Light: soft light from the upper left, gentle on his thin face. The light shows a faint stoop in the line of his back. Expression: quiet and grateful, lonely, the mild, lowered look of a man who is happy to be allowed to stay.

people.imagined: A former pill thief with a pocket that clinks, grinning as he runs errands.
people.subject: The moment: sprinting through a market with a grin, one hand clamped on a pocket that clinks, a former pill thief running errands. Face: most important, a bulging coat pocket that visibly sags and a hand clamped over it. It is a thin, wiry, grinning face of eighteen, brown, with bright shifty eyes, thick brows, a sharp nose and a scab on the chin. Hair: black and spiky. Body: skinny, running on the balls of his feet, leaning forward with one arm swinging and the other clamped to the pocket. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp outer-gate robe cut short, a pill-shop runner's cord tight round the waist and bouncing, and sandals. Hands and objects: one hand over the sagging pocket, the copper coins in it bound with a bit of string so they cannot ring, though they do. The coins are dull brown and tied in a rag with a bit of string. Background: a busy market street with awnings, hanging lanterns, blurred crowds. Light: bright light from the upper left, slicing across the awnings and glinting off the coins. A flash of light crosses his grin as he passes. Expression: cheeky and quick, a darting, delighted grin of a boy who has not yet stopped running from being caught.

people.imagined: A midwife's first disciple with brisk, clean-nailed hands, wanting to be on the step every day.
people.subject: The moment: washing her hands briskly at a basin and drying them, ready. Face, most important: spotless pale clean nails on quick strong hands, held up. A bright, neat, rosy face of nineteen; brown eyes; neat brows; a small nose; a brisk smile. Her cheeks are rosy, her eyes bright and brisk, and her mouth set in readiness. Hair: black, in a tight bun. Body: small, quick. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp inner-gate robe, a white apron, sleeves tied. The white apron is crisp, the robe's sleeves tied above the elbow, the hands pink from scrubbing, and a small basin of water sits at her side. Hands: held up, clean. Background: a healing room. Behind her a bright healing room, pallets in rows, and sun through paper windows. Light: bright light from the upper left. Qi: a faint warm green. She stands tall and straight with her hands held up at chest height, elbows in, as a surgeon would, her sleeves tied neatly; the bright light is clean on her face and bounces off the water in the basin. Her hair has a single green pin, the water in the basin is clear, and a folded towel hangs over her shoulder. Expression: brisk, eager, kind.

people.imagined: Walking in the haze on a path, a council held on foot. The damp hem, the tea-stained thumb, the whisk like a fly-swat in his belt. He is thinking of whom to hand the sect to.
people.subject: The moment: walking a misty path, he stops and turns with a mild, interested look, a council held on foot, thinking of whom to hand the sect to. Face: most important, a white horsehair whisk pushed through his belt like a fly-swat, and a tea-stained brown thumb held up against his chest. He is a small, round-shouldered man of about fifty-five with a round, plain, kind face, weathered light brown, small mild dark eyes, thin grey brows, a blunt nose, a gentle half-smile, large slightly uneven ears, a few grey whiskers missed by the razor, and fine smile-lines round the eyes. Hair: grey-black, in a plain topknot with a wooden pin, damp with haze. Body: short, round-shouldered and relaxed. Clothing: a grey-green hemp robe dyed with haze-indigo, laundered so often the colour is soft as a pond at dusk, clean but darker and damp at the hem, narrow sleeves, a grey scarf wound at the neck against the damp, and a braided hemp cord belt with a small tea-gourd hung from it. Hands and objects: a small clay tea bowl in one hand, the thumb stained; a faint green haze clings to the sleeves. Background: tall dark pine trunks evenly spaced in pale green haze, a stone step leading down a gentle slope, a small paper lantern on a bough. Light: pale diffuse light from the upper left. Expression: a mild, interested look with soft eyes and a patient, peaceable smile as he turns.

people.imagined: At the founder's grave on the ridge, dry in the cold, refusing to stand in the haze. She is thinking of her disciple and what the ridge made the sect.
people.subject: The moment: standing by an old grave under a sideways pine, tall and unmoving, she looks at the viewer with a long hard stare, refusing to stand in the haze and thinking of her disciple and what the ridge made the sect. Face: most important, hands cracked like tree bark, grey and deeply fissured, folded before her, above a long bony face. She appears about sixty-five, with a tall, narrow, bony, pale weathered face, deep lines, sharp pale grey eyes, thick straight grey brows, a long hooked nose, a bloodless flat hard mouth, cheekbones sharp as blades and fine dry lines across the cheeks like cracks in old bark. Hair: grey, cut straight at the jaw, no ornament. Body: tall, bony and straight-backed. Clothing: an old-style ridge robe of undyed hemp, the colour of old bone and stiff as board, clean and bone dry despite the mist, with a wide plain sleeve, a collar crossed in the ridge style, and a rope belt; no green. Hands and objects: folded, bark-cracked; a faint dark green-brown mist behind them. Background: a weathered stone marker at the foot of a huge sideways-bending pine propped by pale braces, the ridge dropping away into a sea of cloud, a few banners without writing fluttering on poles. Light: cold grey light from the upper left. Expression: a long, hard, dry stare with a tight mouth and lined, unyielding features.

people.imagined: At the Green Furnace, tasting a pill, lips tinted green; he wants to brew correctly the pill that killed his teacher.
people.subject: The moment: at a furnace he holds a pill to his lips and tastes it with a long, quiet, analytical look; he wants to brew correctly the pill that killed his teacher. Face: most important, lips tinted a faint green from tasting pills for three centuries, plainly green against pale skin, with soot black in the creases of his knuckles. It is a lean, long, dry face of about fifty, pale, with hollow cheeks, deep-set sharply focused dark eyes, thick black brows, a sharp nose, a thin mouth with green lips and gums, and a pale line of old burn-marks along the jaw. Hair: black with iron grey, tied in a topknot with a green jade pin. Body: lean, upright and taut. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with the sleeves rolled and bound tight at the wrist with cords against sparks, a heavy charcoal-clamp apron singed brown at the hem, and an elder's sash of green silk stained near the knot with a dark drop of tincture. Hands and objects: a pill between sooty fingers; a faint green fire shimmer round it. Background: the great Green Furnace, squat and sooty with a mouth of pale green flame, copper pipes snaking along the walls, racks of small bowls and tongs, thin smoke rising to dark rafters. Light: green furnace glow from the lower left. Expression: diligent and ambitious, grimly honest, the focused look of a man reading a pill by its smell.

people.imagined: In a field at winter dusk, broad and slow, brown as the earth, scars of lime-burn on both forearms.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a winter field at dusk, broad and slow, he scoops up earth and lets it fall through his fingers. Face: most important, pale lime-burn scars mottling both bare, thick forearms, and soil dark under every nail. It is a broad, slow, brown face of about fifty, brown as a winter field, with patient dark eyes slightly yellowed at the whites, thick black brows, a broad nose, a quiet mouth, short grey stubble, a thick creased neck and big brown ears. Hair: black with grey at the temples, cropped. Body: broad, heavy and slow. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe, mended at the cuffs, under a thick sleeveless lime-kiln jacket of pale grey quilted cloth stained at the hem with white lime dust and tied with cloth toggles, a rope belt carrying a small pouch of seed, and boots caked in clay. Hands and objects: a handful of dark soil falling through the fingers; a faint brown earth haze. Background: a long winter field of ploughed furrows running to a line of bare trees, a lone ox standing steaming, thin smoke rising from a lime-kiln chimney, a rose-and-grey sky. Light: low warm light from the upper left. Expression: diligent and humble, loyal, the settled, unhurried look of a man who has finished the day's work and is reading the soil.

people.imagined: On the Hàn Tân quay in the morning, the lamp unlit at his hip, a white scar in his eyebrow from the ice; he wants the border pushed back.
people.subject: The moment: standing on the Hàn Tân stone quay in the cold morning, squinting across the river toward a border, jaw set, wanting the border pushed back. Face: most important, a white scar slicing straight through his left eyebrow and parting it in two, and a squint that deepens the lines around his eyes. It is a weathered, thick-necked, heavy-jawed face of about fifty, red-brown, with narrow pale nearly lashless eyes from ice glare, thick grey brows, a flat nose, red-veined cheeks and a hard mouth. Hair: grey-black, cropped short. Body: thick-necked and broad. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe under a heavy dark winter quay coat of black wool lined with grey fur at throat and cuffs, reinforced at the shoulders with sealskin, a blue Cold Ford sash wound twice round the waist, and a small unlit brass quay lamp with a ring handle, dull with age, hung at the hip. Hands and objects: gripping a spear shaft; a faint blue frost in the air. Background: the quay's stone edge running into fog over a broad river, a long wooden boat with a lantern at its prow moored there, a line of watch-posts dark on the far bank. Light: cold morning light from the upper left. Expression: warlike and brave, vengeful, a hard squint that does not blink at the glare.

people.imagined: On a harbour, laughing a laugh that carries, a whale-cast brass lock on a cord at her throat, rolling walk; looking south for her father's sabre.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a harbour quay, laughing with her head back, a laugh that carries across water, looking south for her father's sabre. Face: most important, a thumb-sized brass lock with a keyhole, cast from a whale-bone mould, on a cord at her throat, bright against dark skin, and a wide laughing mouth. She appears about sixty-two, a short woman with salt-cracked brown skin full of lines, bright small black eyes, thick white bristly brows that rise as she laughs, a flat nose, white uneven teeth in a wide open mouth, and a tiny gold hoop in one ear. Hair: white, in a short sea-knot with a bit of cord. Body: short, rolling and broad. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe hitched at the knee, a salt-crusted oiled-canvas deck cape stiff as board and white at the folds with dried salt, and a dark blue port-house sash with a knotted rope tail. Hands and objects: a wide-spread gesture of both hands; a faint blue water spray in the air. Background: a harbour quay crowded with masts and furled sails, barrels, stacked salt-chests and rope coils, gulls wheeling against a clear wind-swept sky, a sail-boat heeling in the bay. Light: bright sea light from the upper left. Expression: a huge rolling laugh with her head thrown back, crinkled eyes, wide mouth and a gleam of wanting.

people.imagined: In a garden at morning, sleeves rolled, a moss-furred mirror at her waist, soft-spoken; she keeps the sect quiet and green.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in a garden bed, she looks up softly, sleeves rolled to the elbows, a bright small green sprout resting in her palm; she keeps the sect quiet and green. Face: most important, a small round bronze mirror furred green with moss hanging at her waist, and sleeves rolled above bare forearms. It is a slight, gentle, narrow face of thirty-five, fair, with pale grey-green eyes like young leaves, soft straight thin brows, a small straight nose, a small still soft smile and faint freckles over the cheekbones. Hair: dark brown, in a loose low knot with a green cord. Body: slight and slim. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with a true disciple's pale green silk collar and sash, the sleeves rolled twice above the elbow exposing slender wrists stained green at the nails, the moss-furred mirror hanging from a plaited green cord, and the knees of the robe damp with garden earth. Hands and objects: a green sprout in one palm; a faint pale green sparkle on its leaves. Background: a long garden bed of herb seedlings in orderly rows, a bamboo trellis with climbing vines, a stone path, soft morning mist glowing gold at the edges. Light: soft morning light from the upper left. Expression: compassionate and humble, patient, the gentle, soft-spoken attention of a woman who is looking at a seedling.

people.imagined: On the ridge, burnt dark by the wind, a long cypress banner-pole across his back, wanting to bring the sect's heart back up the mountain.
people.subject: The moment: standing on the ridge in a fierce wind, he glares into the distance with arrogant certainty, wanting to bring the sect's heart back up the mountain. Face: most important, a long plain cypress banner-pole rising behind his shoulder across his back, smooth and dark with a bare crossbar and no cloth, and very dark wind-burnt skin. It is a tall, hard face of about forty, burnt by the wind to the colour of dark tea, with taut cheeks, fierce narrow dark eyes, heavy straight brows, a strong straight nose, a set mouth and a pale scar nicking the chin. Hair: black, cropped short. Body: tall, broad and hard. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Cliff Hall, clean and spotless, under a grey wind-coat woven with a metallic sheen, with scarred dull stone-cutter's leather bracers. Hands and objects: heavily calloused hands folded across his chest; a faint steel-grey sheen on the coat. Background: a high bare ridge of grey rock against a hard blue sky, loose scree sliding at the edge, a single scrubby pine leaning in the gale. Light: hard bright light from the upper left. Expression: arrogant and stubborn, diligent, a narrowed stare of a man used to staring down a gale.

people.imagined: Talking fast while he walks fast, chalk on his cuffs, an old man in a hurry to hear the ninth layer read right.
people.subject: The moment: mid-stride and mid-sentence, he gestures quickly with chalk-white hands, an old man in a hurry to hear the ninth layer read right. Face: most important, white array chalk dust thick on both cuffs and fingers, and a mouth caught mid-word. It is a wiry, narrow, quick old face of about sixty, brown, deeply seamed, with bright darting dark eyes under thick white brows, a sharp nose slightly red at the end, and a quick open mouth, every wrinkle seeming to be in the middle of a word. Hair: white, wild, tied in a short tail. Body: thin, wiry and forward-leaning. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe hitched at the sash for walking, a green array-hall sash stained with chalk, chalk smearing both cuffs and the front, and a bundle of chalk sticks poking from one sleeve. Hands and objects: a stick of chalk in one hand; a faint green haze in the air. Background: a row of lichen-covered array stones disappearing into pale haze, a stone path winding between them, a few distant pines showing through the mist. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: generous and gregarious, stubborn, impatient, the eager, tumbling look of a man talking faster than he can walk.

people.imagined: A small stooped woman in a herb garden smelling of angelica root, a burn scar on her cheek from the fire that took a hall.
people.subject: The moment: small and stooped in a herb garden, she looks up with a quiet, cautious look, holding a root of angelica. Face: most important, a shiny pale-pink burn scar along her left cheek from jaw to ear, tight and plainly visible, puckering the corner of her mouth, above her bent shoulders. She appears about sixty, with a small, lined, brown face, wary kind dark eyes with drooping lids, thin grey brows, a small nose and a thoughtful mouth. Hair: white-grey, in a bun with a plain pin. Body: small and stooped. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe, neatly mended at the elbows, an elder's grey-green sash gone soft and faded, and a herb-stained apron stained yellow and smelling of angelica, with a small cloth bag of dried root at her belt. Hands and objects: holding the angelica root in both hands; a faint green-gold tint in the air. Background: rows of herb beds in neat squares, a bamboo frame with drying leaves, a low stone wall. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: patient and honest, cautious, the careful, steady look of a woman who has been burned by a fire that took a hall and now watches every spark.

people.imagined: Standing very straight at the Hall of Rules, speaking in the fewest words he can; he dug for nine days once.
people.subject: The moment: standing perfectly straight at a hall door, unsmiling, about to give a one-word verdict; he once dug for nine days. Face: most important, an utterly stern square face and a ramrod-straight posture, silver at the temples. He is about forty-five, with a square, unsmiling brown face, a clean-shaven blue-grey jaw, steady dark eyes that never blink long, heavy straight brows with deep vertical lines between them, a strong nose and a closed hard mouth. Hair: black, cut sharp and grey at the temples, cropped. Body: square and straight, hands at his sides. Clothing: the dry undyed hemp robe of the Hall of Rules, immaculately clean and formal, cut with severe plainness, the collar closed to the throat, the sleeves narrow with buttoned cuffs, a dark sash tied flat, and a small flat plain wooden tablet hanging at the belt. Hands and objects: hands at his sides, still; a faint grey-green tint in the air. Background: a plain hall with bare dark pillars, a long polished floor, a single pale window; nothing is decorated. Light: flat light from the upper left. Expression: just and stern, calm, the fixed, unsmiling gaze of a man who speaks in the fewest words he can and means all of them.

people.imagined: The Marten Yard keeper, whose fur collar is a living silver marten sleeping round her neck.
people.subject: The moment: sharp-eyed and quick in a pine yard, she strokes with one hand the silver marten asleep round her neck like a fur collar. Face: most important, a living silver marten curled asleep round her neck as a collar, plump and drowsy, its small face resting on her shoulder and its tail hanging over it. It is a sharp, quick, thin face of about forty, brown, with a pointed chin, bright fast dark eyes, thin arched brows, a long thin nose that wrinkles when she sniffs, a thin sly smile and a pale line of an old scratch across one cheek. Hair: black, in a tight high knot. Body: lean and quick. Clothing: a clean green-grey hemp robe with a green elder's sash, a scratched leather glove on the left hand, and a pouch of dried meat at her belt. Hands and objects: one hand stroking the marten, a small spirit beast; a faint silver-green sheen on its fur. Background: a pine yard with wooden hutches and perches, small silver shapes darting among roots, sunlight slanting through branches. Light: bright light from the upper left. Expression: reclusive and sly, greedy, the knowing, sidelong look of the Marten Yard keeper who trusts her animals more than the people who come to ask for them.

people.imagined: Elegant in a Tùng Đào-cut robe dyed Thúy Vi green, quick eyes weighing a courtesy; she speaks both sects' courtesies.
people.subject: The moment: bowing a half-courtesy with a slight smile, her quick eyes weighing the viewer. Face, most important: a robe cut in a wide-collared Pine Palace fashion but dyed Thúy Vi grey-green, an elegant mix. An elegant, quick-eyed, oval face of thirty-eight; fair skin; sharp bright eyes; thin arched brows; a fine straight nose; a polished smile. Her skin is fair and fine, her lips are painted a faint rose, and her sharp dark eyes judge every word; a tiny jade drop swings from each ear. Hair: black, in an elaborate high coil with a pine-green jade pin. Body: slim, graceful. Clothing: a Pine Palace-cut robe with a deep V collar dyed grey-green, a pale green silk sash, wide sleeves. The robe's wide deep-V collar is edged with thin pine-green piping, its grey-green dye is perfectly even, the pale green silk sash is tied in a flat bow, the wide sleeves are lined in a lighter shade, and a small jade seal-box hangs at her hip. Hands: one hand extended. Background: a pale hall. Behind her a pale audience hall with lacquered pillars, a screen painted with distant pines without writing, and soft light from tall lattice windows. Light: soft light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green sheen. Expression: a polite, slight smile with quick eyes that weigh the viewer and a smooth, courteous brow.
